# EARWITNESS

**Discover the invisible in a video.** Drop in any clip and a forensic HUD
streams findings from the signals a viewer never notices: the hum of the power
grid, flicker of the lights, heartbeats in skin colour, tones above hearing,
the rhythm of the encoder, the physics of the camera sensor.

Built for HackTheBurgh (G-Research: *discover the invisible in data*).

```sh
uv sync                                  # Python 3.14 (uv fetches it); needs ffmpeg + tesseract
cp .env.example .env                     # then paste your Tiger Data service URL
uv run earwitness db migrate             # create the schema (the server also does this)
(cd web && npm install && npm run build) # the HUD
uv run earwitness serve                  # http://127.0.0.1:8765
uv run earwitness demo --out demo        # demo pack with planted ground truth
```

Optional extras, configured in `.env` (gitignored):

```sh
OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-...          # transcript, AI visual analyst, narrative brief, geolocation judge
EARWITNESS_GEOSLEUTH=~/.cache/earwitness/vendor/geo-sleuth/skills/geo-sleuth
```

For geolocation, clone https://github.com/Oldcircle/geo-sleuth (MIT) and point
`EARWITNESS_GEOSLEUTH` at its `skills/geo-sleuth` folder. Earwitness runs its
local intake (edge crops + OCR, no reverse image search), then a vision model
estimates the location **blind**, without the file's GPS. When GPS exists, the
error in km is reported. The key is read from the environment only and never
reaches the browser. Frames and audio are sent to OpenAI only when the key is
set.

## Database (Tiger Data)

Earwitness requires a [Tiger Data](https://www.tigerdata.com) (TimescaleDB)
service. Set `TIMESCALE_SERVICE_URL` in `.env`; the server refuses to start
without it. Tables live in the schema `EARWITNESS_DB_SCHEMA` (default
`earwitness`):

| Table | What | Kind |
|---|---|---|
| `grid_frequency` | Every GB grid-frequency sample fetched from NESO (1 s) / Elexon (15 s) | hypertable, segmented by source |
| `grid_coverage` | Windows already fetched; a covered window needs no HTTP | table |
| `grid_frequency_1m` | One-minute avg/min/max of the grid record | continuous aggregate |
| `cases` | Every analysed clip: hash, verdict, the time the grid dated it to | table |
| `findings` | Every finding of every case | hypertable, segmented by case |

`cases/<id>/events.jsonl` stays the record a case replays from; the database
is the shared grid record and the index across cases.

```sh
uv run earwitness db status         # hypertables, sizes, stored grid windows, counts
uv run earwitness db import-cache   # load old ~/.cache/earwitness/grid/*.npz windows
```

API: `GET /api/search?since=&until=&severity=&module=&q=` (findings across
cases), `GET /api/search/dated?start=&end=` (clips the grid dated into a
window), `GET /api/grid?start=&end=` (stored grid record, per minute).

The UI opens in a plain-language **Simple** view (verdict + "Has it been
edited? / When? / Where? / Who? / Anything hidden?" cards with confidence);
**Technical details** shows the full forensic HUD.

## Modules

| Module | What it finds | How |
|---|---|---|
| **Provenance** | Device, GPS (with street address), time zone, which clock stamps start vs end, editing software, rewritten container, sun position at the claimed time and place | ffprobe tags, ISO-BMFF box walk, filename/container clock reconciliation, NOAA solar model, OSM reverse geocoding |
| **Frame timeline** | Hard cuts (ignoring pans and flashes), dropped/duplicated frames, off-rhythm keyframes, bitrate | packet table, frame and histogram differencing with neighbourhood tests |
| **Spectral** | Ultrasonic/hidden tones, DTMF keypad digits, perfect digital silence, room-tone jumps, lossy-encode bandwidth cliffs, Doppler sweeps of passing aircraft | STFT, Goertzel, noise-floor step detection, Viterbi tone tracking |
| **Mains hum / ENF** | Grid (50/60 Hz), date and time **to the second**, audio splices by phase jumps and by windows that date to different times; also dates **silent** footage from lamp flicker | hum tracking vs NESO 1 s / Elexon grid records, fetched by HTTP range around the claimed time |
| **Light & flicker** | Mains flicker hidden in rolling-shutter banding: grid region, sensor readout time, a visual grid-frequency trace; lighting vs the sun | per-row temporal spectra, alias prediction, phase coherence down the frame |
| **Pulse (rPPG)** | Heart rate of each face on camera; Eulerian colour-magnification video | YuNet faces, POS method, chroma-only temporal band-pass |
| **Pixel forensics** | Copy-move (cloned) regions; error-level and noise-residual heatmaps | ORB self-matching with displacement clustering; ELA; regression-normalised residuals |
| **A/V sync** | Audio shifted or re-dubbed against the picture | onset envelope × motion energy cross-correlation, checked for consistency across the clip |
| **OCR** | Postcodes, number plates, phone numbers, URLs, dates, clock times in frame | Tesseract, two layout passes |
| **Transcript** / **AI analyst** | Speech; place, time of day, notable details and visual manipulation signs (labelled AI-inferred) | OpenAI (optional) |
| **Geo-sleuth intake** | geo-sleuth intake dossier for the sharpest frames | optional bridge; set `EARWITNESS_GEOSLEUTH` |
| **Case brief** | Verdict (EDITED / POSSIBLY EDITED / NO SIGNS OF EDITING) with WHEN / WHERE / DEVICE / PEOPLE / INTEGRITY / HIDDEN lines citing finding ids; flags edits **corroborated** by sound and picture | deterministic rules; plus an AI narrative if enabled |

The HUD has **ENHANCE**: drag a box on the paused video and multi-frame
super-resolution aligns ±N neighbouring frames (ECC) and merges them robustly,
the way burst photography does, so moving parts do not ghost.

## Verified

`uv run pytest` (17 tests, ~100 s; needs the database, each run uses its own
throwaway schema seeded with the stored grid record) runs every module on synthetic clips with
planted ground truth:

| Planted | Recovered |
|---|---|
| 18.5 kHz tone, DTMF `1984#`, 0.3 s digital silence @12 s, room-tone jump + cut @20 s | all found; cut and audio break **corroborated** |
| 72 bpm skin pulse | 72 bpm |
| 100 Hz flicker @30 fps / 120 Hz @25 fps, 20 ms readout | 50 Hz / 60 Hz grid, 20.0 ms |
| Lamps following the real GB grid at 2024-03-12 23:10:00, metadata 20 min off | dated **23:10:00** from lighting alone, metadata contradiction flagged |
| Mains hum, spliced with audio from 30 min later | dated to the second; phase jump @150 s; two date clusters |
| Audio shifted +250 ms | +260 ms; aligned clip +10 ms |
| 90×70 px clone | offset (300, 140) px |
| Sign with postcode, plate, URL, hours | all read |

Checked on real iPhone/Android clips: no false cuts on fast pans, no false hum
or flicker, GPS → street address, time zone reconstructed from filename vs
container clock.

## Honest limits

- Phone microphones filter out low frequencies and iPhones lock exposure to
  the flicker period, so many phone clips carry neither hum nor visible
  flicker. The modules say so instead of guessing.
- Pulse from handheld, compressed phone video is usually low-confidence and
  is labelled as such.
- Grain/ELA heatmaps on video are shaped by the codec and are for visual
  inspection only; they never raise findings.
- Automatic grid records cover GB (NESO, Elexon). Other grids need a CSV.

## Layout

`src/earwitness/modules/`: one file per module (common `Reporter` interface in
`base.py`). `server/`: FastAPI + WebSocket event stream (`docs/PROTOCOL.md`),
enhance and HTML report. `web/`: React/Vite HUD. The original CLI (`analyse`,
`reference`, `log-flights`, `synthesise`) still works; see `uv run earwitness -h`.

189	        self.findings: list[Finding] = []
190	        self.artifacts: dict[str, Artifact] = {}
191	        self._cache: dict[str, Any] = {}
192	        self._locks: dict[str, asyncio.Lock] = {}
193	        self._published: dict[str, Any] = {}
194	        self._events: dict[str, asyncio.Event] = {}
195	
196	    async def _cached[T](self, key: str, make: Callable[[], Awaitable[T]]) -> T:
197	        lock = self._locks.setdefault(key, asyncio.Lock())
198	
199	        async with lock:
200	            if key not in self._cache:
201	                self._cache[key] = await make()
202	
203	        return self._cache[key]
204	
205	    # ---- shared results between modules ---------------------------------
206	    def publish(self, key: str, value: Any) -> None:
207	        self._published[key] = value
208	        self._events.setdefault(key, asyncio.Event()).set()
209	
210	    async def wait_for(self, key: str, timeout: float = 600.0) -> Any:
211	        event = self._events.setdefault(key, asyncio.Event())
212	
213	        try:
214	            await asyncio.wait_for(event.wait(), timeout)
215	        except TimeoutError:
216	            return None
217	
218	        return self._published.get(key)
219	
220	    # ---- probing and decoding -------------------------------------------
221	    async def probe(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
222	        async def make() -> dict[str, Any]:
223	            output = await run_tool(
224	                "ffprobe",
225	                "-v",
226	                "error",
227	                "-print_format",
228	                "json",
229	                "-show_format",
230	                "-show_streams",
231	                self.path,
232	            )
233	
234	            return json.loads(output) if output else {}
235	
236	        return await self._cached("probe", make)
237	
238	    async def video_info(self) -> VideoInfo | None:
239	        async def make() -> VideoInfo | None:
240	            probe = await self.probe()
241	            stream = next(
242	                (
243	                    s
244	                    for s in probe.get("streams", [])
245	                    if s.get("codec_type") == "video"
246	                    and not s.get("disposition", {}).get("attached_pic")
247	                ),
248	                None,
249	            )
250	
251	            if stream is None:
252	                return None
253	
254	            fps = _rate(stream.get("avg_frame_rate")) or _rate(
255	                stream.get("r_frame_rate")
256	            )
257	            duration = float(
258	                stream.get("duration") or probe.get("format", {}).get("duration") or 0
259	            )
260	            frames = int(stream.get("nb_frames") or round(duration * (fps or 30)))
261	            rotation = 0
262	
263	            for side in stream.get("side_data_list", []):
264	                if "rotation" in side:
265	                    rotation = int(side["rotation"])
266	
267	            if "rotate" in stream.get("tags", {}):
268	                rotation = int(stream["tags"]["rotate"])
269	
270	            width, height = int(stream["width"]), int(stream["height"])
271	
272	            if abs(rotation) % 180 == 90:
273	                width, height = height, width
274	
275	            return VideoInfo(
276	                width=width,
277	                height=height,
278	                fps=fps or 30.0,
279	                frame_count=frames,
280	                duration_s=duration,
281	                codec=stream.get("codec_name", "?"),
282	                rotation=rotation,
283	            )
284	
285	        return await self._cached("video_info", make)
286	
287	    async def audio(self) -> media.Recording | None:
288	        async def make() -> media.Recording | None:
289	            recording = await media.load(self.path)
290	
291	            return None if isinstance(recording, ForensicError) else recording
292	
293	        return await self._cached("audio", make)
294	
295	    async def audio_native(self) -> tuple[np.ndarray, int] | None:
296	        """Mono audio at the file's own sample rate (for high-frequency work)."""
297	
298	        async def make() -> tuple[np.ndarray, int] | None:
299	            probe = await self.probe()
300	            stream = next(
301	                (s for s in probe.get("streams", []) if s.get("codec_type") == "audio"),
302	                None,
303	            )
304	
305	            if stream is None:
306	                return None
307	
308	            rate = int(stream.get("sample_rate") or 44_100)
309	            output = await run_tool(
310	                "ffmpeg", "-nostdin", "-v", "error", "-i", self.path, "-vn",
311	                "-ac", "1", "-ar", str(rate), "-f", "f32le", "-",
312	            )  # fmt: skip
313	
314	            if not output:
315	                return None
316	
317	            return np.frombuffer(output, dtype=np.float32).astype(np.float64), rate
318	
319	        return await self._cached("audio_native", make)
320	
321	    async def frames(self, width: int, *, max_frames: int = 9_000) -> Frames | None:
322	        """Every frame (up to max_frames) scaled to ``width`` pixels wide."""
323	
324	        async def make() -> Frames | None:
325	            info = await self.video_info()
326	
327	            if info is None:
328	                return None
329	
330	            height = max(2, int(round(width * info.height / info.width / 2)) * 2)
331	            args = ["ffmpeg", "-nostdin", "-v", "error", "-i", self.path]
332	            args += ["-frames:v", str(max_frames), "-vf", f"scale={width}:{height}"]
333	            args += [
334	                "-fps_mode",
335	                "passthrough",
336	                "-f",
337	                "rawvideo",
338	                "-pix_fmt",
339	                "rgb24",
340	                "-",
341	            ]
342	            output = await run_tool(*args)
343	
344	            if not output:
345	                return None
346	
347	            pixels = np.frombuffer(output, dtype=np.uint8)
348	            count = len(pixels) // (width * height * 3)
349	            pixels = pixels[: count * width * height * 3].reshape(
350	                count, height, width, 3
351	            )
352	            times = await self.frame_times()
353	            times = (
354	                times[:count] if len(times) >= count else np.arange(count) / info.fps
355	            )
356	
357	            return Frames(pixels, times, info.fps)
358	
359	        return await self._cached(f"frames:{width}:{max_frames}", make)
360	
361	    async def frame_table(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
362	        """Per-frame packet facts: pts, type, size, key flag."""
363	
364	        async def make() -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
365	            output = await run_tool(
366	                "ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-select_streams", "v:0",
367	                "-show_entries",
368	                "packet=pts_time,dts_time,size,flags,duration_time",
369	                "-of", "json", self.path,
370	            )  # fmt: skip
371	
372	            if not output:
373	                return []
374	
375	            packets = json.loads(output).get("packets", [])
376	            rows = []
377	
378	            for packet in packets:
379	                if packet.get("pts_time") in (None, "N/A"):
380	                    continue
381	
382	                rows.append(
383	                    {
384	                        "pts": float(packet["pts_time"]),
385	                        "size": int(packet.get("size", 0)),
386	                        "key": "K" in packet.get("flags", ""),
387	                    }
388	                )
389	
390	            rows.sort(key=lambda r: r["pts"])
391	
392	            return rows
393	
394	        return await self._cached("frame_table", make)
395	
396	    async def frame_times(self) -> np.ndarray:
397	        table = await self.frame_table()
398	
399	        if not table:
400	            return np.array([])
401	
402	        times = np.array([row["pts"] for row in table])
403	
404	        return times - times[0]
405	
406	    async def frame_at(
407	        self, time_s: float, *, width: int | None = None
408	    ) -> np.ndarray | None:
409	        """One full-resolution (or scaled) RGB frame at ``time_s``."""
410	        info = await self.video_info()
411	
412	        if info is None:
413	            return None
414	
415	        out_width = width or info.width
416	        out_height = max(2, int(round(out_width * info.height / info.width / 2)) * 2)
417	        output = await run_tool(
418	            "ffmpeg", "-nostdin", "-v", "error", "-ss", f"{max(0.0, time_s):.3f}",
419	            "-i", self.path, "-frames:v", "1",
420	            "-vf", f"scale={out_width}:{out_height}",
421	            "-f", "rawvideo", "-pix_fmt", "rgb24", "-",
422	        )  # fmt: skip
423	
424	        if not output or len(output) < out_width * out_height * 3:
425	            return None
426	
427	        return np.frombuffer(output, dtype=np.uint8)[
428	            : out_width * out_height * 3
429	        ].reshape(out_height, out_width, 3)
430	
431	    async def clip_frames(
432	        self, start_s: float, count: int, *, width: int | None = None
433	    ) -> np.ndarray | None:
434	        """``count`` consecutive RGB frames starting at ``start_s``."""
435	        info = await self.video_info()
436	
437	        if info is None:
438	            return None
439	
440	        out_width = width or info.width
441	        out_height = max(2, int(round(out_width * info.height / info.width / 2)) * 2)
442	        output = await run_tool(
443	            "ffmpeg", "-nostdin", "-v", "error", "-ss", f"{max(0.0, start_s):.3f}",
444	            "-i", self.path, "-frames:v", str(count),
445	            "-vf", f"scale={out_width}:{out_height}",
446	            "-f", "rawvideo", "-pix_fmt", "rgb24", "-",
447	        )  # fmt: skip
448	
449	        if not output:
450	            return None
451	
452	        size = out_width * out_height * 3
453	        n = len(output) // size
454	
455	        return np.frombuffer(output[: n * size], dtype=np.uint8).reshape(
456	            n, out_height, out_width, 3
457	        )
458	
459	
460	def _rate(text: str | None) -> float | None:
461	    if not text or text in ("0/0", "N/A"):
462	        return None
463	
464	    if "/" in text:
465	        numerator, denominator = text.split("/")
466	
467	        return float(numerator) / float(denominator) if float(denominator) else None
468	
469	    return float(text)
470	
471	
472	async def run_tool(*args: str, stdin: bytes | None = None) -> bytes | None:
473	    process = await asyncio.create_subprocess_exec(
474	        *args,
475	        stdin=subprocess.PIPE if stdin is not None else subprocess.DEVNULL,
476	        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
477	        stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
478	    )
479	    stdout, _ = await process.communicate(stdin)
480	
481	    if process.returncode != 0:
482	        return None
483	
484	    return stdout
485	
486	
487	def _jsonable(value: Any) -> Any:
488	    if isinstance(value, dict):
489	        return {str(k): _jsonable(v) for k, v in value.items()}
490	
491	    if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
492	        return [_jsonable(v) for v in value]
493	
494	    if isinstance(value, np.ndarray):
495	        return _jsonable(value.tolist())
496	
497	    if isinstance(value, (np.floating, float)):
498	        f = float(value)
499	
500	        return None if not np.isfinite(f) else round(f, 6)
501	
502	    if isinstance(value, np.integer):
503	        return int(value)
504	
505	    if isinstance(value, np.bool_):
506	        return bool(value)
507	
508	    if hasattr(value, "isoformat"):
509	        return value.isoformat()
510	
511	    return value
512	
513	
514	def downsample_series(
515	    x: np.ndarray, ys: dict[str, np.ndarray], max_points: int = 2_000
516	) -> dict[str, Any]:
517	    """A compact {x, series} payload for the UI's charts."""
518	    x = np.asarray(x, dtype=float)
519	    step = max(1, int(np.ceil(len(x) / max_points)))
520	
521	    return {
522	        "x": np.round(x[::step], 4),
523	        "series": [
524	            {"name": name, "y": np.round(np.asarray(y, dtype=float)[::step], 6)}
525	            for name, y in ys.items()
526	        ],
527	    }
528	
529	
530	def now() -> float:
531	    return time.time()

1	import asyncio
2	import json
3	import os
4	import re
5	from dataclasses import dataclass
6	from datetime import datetime
7	from datetime import timezone
8	
9	import numpy as np
10	
11	from earwitness._common import ForensicError
12	from earwitness._common import OnSuccess
13	
14	ANALYSIS_SAMPLE_RATE = 16_000
15	
16	_ISO6709 = re.compile(r"([+-]\d+(?:\.\d+)?)([+-]\d+(?:\.\d+)?)")
17	_FILENAME_TIME = re.compile(r"(20\d{6})[_-]?(\d{6})")
18	_LOCATION_TAGS = (
19	    "com.apple.quicktime.location.iso6709",
20	    "location",
21	    "location-eng",
22	)
23	
24	
25	class MediaError(ForensicError):
26	    PROBE_FAILED = "probe_failed"
27	    DECODE_FAILED = "decode_failed"
28	    NO_AUDIO = "no_audio"
29	
30	
31	@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
32	class Coordinates:
33	    latitude: float
34	    longitude: float
35	
36	
37	@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
38	class Metadata:
39	    """creation_time is whatever the container says; phones and Google Photos
40	    often store the end of recording rather than the start. filename_time is
41	    parsed from names like 20240722_131415 and is local time, zone unknown.
42	    """
43	
44	    creation_time: datetime | None
45	    location: Coordinates | None
46	    duration_s: float
47	    filename_time: datetime | None
48	
49	
50	@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
51	class Recording:
52	    samples: np.ndarray
53	    sample_rate: int
54	    metadata: Metadata
55	
56	
57	async def _run(*args: str) -> bytes | None:
58	    process = await asyncio.create_subprocess_exec(
59	        *args,
60	        stdout=asyncio.subprocess.PIPE,
61	        stderr=asyncio.subprocess.PIPE,
62	    )
63	    stdout, _ = await process.communicate()
64	
65	    if process.returncode != 0:
66	        return None
67	
68	    return stdout
69	
70	
71	def _parse_time(value: str | None) -> datetime | None:
72	    if value is None:
73	        return None
74	
75	    parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(value)
76	
77	    if parsed.tzinfo is None:
78	        return parsed.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
79	
80	    return parsed.astimezone(timezone.utc)
81	
82	
83	def _parse_filename_time(path: str) -> datetime | None:
84	    found = _FILENAME_TIME.search(os.path.basename(path))
85	
86	    if found is None:
87	        return None
88	
89	    try:
90	        return datetime.strptime(found.group(1) + found.group(2), "%Y%m%d%H%M%S")
91	    # NOTE: strptime has no non-raising form; digits like 20241399 are invalid.
92	    except ValueError:
93	        return None
94	
95	
96	def _parse_location(tags: dict[str, str]) -> Coordinates | None:
97	    for key in _LOCATION_TAGS:
98	        value = tags.get(key)
99	
100	        if value is None:
101	            continue
102	
103	        found = _ISO6709.match(value)
104	
105	        if found is not None:
106	            return Coordinates(float(found.group(1)), float(found.group(2)))
107	
108	    return None
109	
110	
111	def _collect_tags(probe: dict[str, object]) -> dict[str, str]:
112	    tags: dict[str, str] = {}
113	    sections = [probe.get("format", {}), *probe.get("streams", [])]
114	
115	    for section in sections:
116	        for key, value in section.get("tags", {}).items():
117	            tags.setdefault(key.lower(), value)
118	
119	    return tags
120	
121	
122	async def probe(path: str) -> OnSuccess[Metadata]:
123	    output = await _run(
124	        "ffprobe",
125	        "-v",
126	        "error",
127	        "-print_format",
128	        "json",
129	        "-show_format",
130	        "-show_streams",
131	        path,
132	    )
133	
134	    if output is None:
135	        return MediaError.PROBE_FAILED
136	
137	    data = json.loads(output)
138	
139	    if not any(s.get("codec_type") == "audio" for s in data.get("streams", [])):
140	        return MediaError.NO_AUDIO
141	
142	    tags = _collect_tags(data)
143	    duration = float(data.get("format", {}).get("duration", 0.0))
144	
145	    return Metadata(
146	        creation_time=_parse_time(tags.get("creation_time")),
147	        location=_parse_location(tags),
148	        duration_s=duration,
149	        filename_time=_parse_filename_time(path),
150	    )
151	
152	
153	async def load(path: str) -> OnSuccess[Recording]:
154	    metadata = await probe(path)
155	
156	    if isinstance(metadata, ForensicError):
157	        return metadata
158	
159	    output = await _run(
160	        "ffmpeg",
161	        "-nostdin",
162	        "-v",
163	        "error",
164	        "-i",
165	        path,
166	        "-vn",
167	        "-ac",
168	        "1",
169	        "-ar",
170	        str(ANALYSIS_SAMPLE_RATE),
171	        "-f",
172	        "f32le",
173	        "-",
174	    )
175	
176	    if output is None or len(output) == 0:
177	        return MediaError.DECODE_FAILED
178	
179	    samples = np.frombuffer(output, dtype=np.float32).astype(np.float64)
180	
181	    return Recording(samples, ANALYSIS_SAMPLE_RATE, metadata)

23	class Case:
24	    def __init__(
25	        self, case_id: str, workdir: str, filename: str, options: dict[str, Any]
26	    ):
27	        self.id = case_id
28	        self.workdir = workdir
29	        self.filename = filename
30	        self.options = options
31	        self.created = time.time()
32	        self.events: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
33	        self.listeners: set[asyncio.Queue[dict[str, Any]]] = set()
34	        self.status = "queued"
35	        self.ctx: CaseContext | None = None
36	        self.task: asyncio.Task[None] | None = None
37	        self._log = None
38	
39	    @property
40	    def evidence_path(self) -> str:
41	        return os.path.join(
42	            self.workdir, "evidence" + os.path.splitext(self.filename)[1].lower()
43	        )

45	    def emit(self, event: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
46	        event = {"seq": len(self.events), "ts": round(time.time(), 3), **event}
47	        self.events.append(event)
48	
49	        if self._log is None:
50	            self._log = open(os.path.join(self.workdir, "events.jsonl"), "a")
51	
52	        self._log.write(json.dumps(event) + "\n")
53	        self._log.flush()
54	
55	        for queue in list(self.listeners):
56	            queue.put_nowait(event)
57	
58	    def summary(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
59	        case_event = next((e for e in self.events if e["type"] == "case"), None)
60	        findings = [e["finding"] for e in self.events if e["type"] == "finding"]
61	        brief = next(
62	            (
63	                e["artifact"]["data"]
64	                for e in reversed(self.events)
65	                if e["type"] == "artifact" and e["artifact"]["id"] == "brief:brief"
66	            ),
67	            {},
68	        )
69	
70	        return {
71	            "id": self.id,
72	            "filename": self.filename,
73	            "created": self.created,
74	            "status": self.status,
75	            "findings": len(findings),
76	            "warnings": sum(f["severity"] in ("warning", "critical") for f in findings),
77	            "case": case_event["case"] if case_event else None,
78	            "verdict": brief.get("verdict"),
79	            "summary_plain": brief.get("summary_plain"),
80	        }

83	class CaseStore:
84	    def __init__(self, root: str):
85	        self.root = root
86	        self.cases: dict[str, Case] = {}
87	        os.makedirs(root, exist_ok=True)
88	        self._load_existing()
89	
90	    def _load_existing(self) -> None:
91	        for case_id in sorted(os.listdir(self.root)):
92	            workdir = os.path.join(self.root, case_id)
93	            meta_path = os.path.join(workdir, "case.json")
94	
95	            if not os.path.isfile(meta_path):
96	                continue
97	
98	            with open(meta_path) as handle:
99	                meta = json.load(handle)
100	
101	            case = Case(case_id, workdir, meta["filename"], meta.get("options", {}))
102	            case.created = meta.get("created", case.created)
103	            events_path = os.path.join(workdir, "events.jsonl")
104	
105	            if os.path.isfile(events_path):
106	                with open(events_path) as handle:
107	                    case.events = [json.loads(line) for line in handle if line.strip()]
108	
109	            done = any(e["type"] == "done" for e in case.events)
110	            case.status = "done" if done else "interrupted"
111	            self.cases[case_id] = case

113	    def create(self, filename: str, options: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> Case:
114	        case_id = time.strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S-") + uuid.uuid4().hex[:6]
115	        workdir = os.path.join(self.root, case_id)
116	        os.makedirs(workdir)
117	        case = Case(case_id, workdir, os.path.basename(filename), options or {})
118	
119	        with open(os.path.join(workdir, "case.json"), "w") as handle:
120	            json.dump(
121	                {
122	                    "filename": case.filename,
123	                    "created": case.created,
124	                    "options": case.options,
125	                },
126	                handle,
127	            )
128	
129	        self.cases[case_id] = case
130	
131	        return case
132	
133	    def delete(self, case_id: str) -> bool:
134	        case = self.cases.pop(case_id, None)
135	
136	        if case is None:
137	            return False
138	
139	        if case.task and not case.task.done():
140	            case.task.cancel()
141	
142	        shutil.rmtree(case.workdir, ignore_errors=True)
143	
144	        return True
145	
146	    async def sync_index(self) -> None:
147	        """Backfill the database index with every case on disk."""
148	        for case in list(self.cases.values()):
149	            await db.index_case(case)
150	
151	    def start(self, case: Case, *, only: list[str] | None = None) -> None:
152	        case.task = asyncio.create_task(run_case(case, only=only))
153

155	async def _make_proxy(case: Case) -> str | None:
156	    """An H.264 copy every browser can play (phones record HEVC/VP9)."""
157	    out = os.path.join(case.workdir, "proxy.mp4")
158	
159	    if os.path.isfile(out):
160	        return out
161	
162	    result = await run_tool(
163	        "ffmpeg", "-nostdin", "-v", "error", "-y", "-i", case.evidence_path,
164	        "-map", "0:v:0?", "-map", "0:a:0?",
165	        "-vf", "scale='min(1280,iw)':-2",
166	        "-c:v", "libx264", "-preset", "veryfast", "-crf", "23", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p",
167	        "-c:a", "aac", "-b:a", "128k", "-movflags", "+faststart", out,
168	    )  # fmt: skip
169	
170	    return out if result is not None and os.path.isfile(out) else None
171

174	    await run_tool(
175	        "ffmpeg", "-nostdin", "-v", "error", "-y", "-ss", "0.5", "-i", case.evidence_path,
176	        "-frames:v", "1", "-vf", "scale=320:-2,format=yuvj420p", os.path.join(case.workdir, "thumb.jpg"),
177	    )  # fmt: skip

180	def _hash_file(path: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
181	    sha, md5 = hashlib.sha256(), hashlib.md5()
182	
183	    with open(path, "rb") as handle:
184	        while chunk := handle.read(1 << 20):
185	            sha.update(chunk)
186	            md5.update(chunk)
187	
188	    return sha.hexdigest(), md5.hexdigest()
189	
190	
191	def _fps(text: str | None) -> float | None:
192	    if not text or text in ("0/0", "N/A"):
193	        return None
194	
195	    num, _, den = text.partition("/")
196	
197	    return round(float(num) / float(den), 3) if den and float(den) else float(num)
198	
199	
200	def _num(value: Any) -> float | None:
201	    try:
202	        return float(value)
203	    except TypeError, ValueError:
204	        return None
205	
206	
207	async def _custody(case: "Case", probe: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
208	    """Chain-of-custody facts: hashes, container, every stream, every tag."""
209	    sha256, md5 = await asyncio.to_thread(_hash_file, case.evidence_path)
210	    fmt = probe.get("format", {})
211	    tags: dict[str, str] = {}
212	
213	    for key, value in fmt.get("tags", {}).items():
214	        tags[key] = str(value)
215	
216	    for stream in probe.get("streams", []):
217	        for key, value in stream.get("tags", {}).items():
218	            tags.setdefault(f"stream{stream.get('index')}.{key}", str(value))
219	
220	    streams = [
221	        {
222	            "index": s.get("index"),
223	            "type": s.get("codec_type"),
224	            "codec": s.get("codec_name"),
225	            "codec_long": s.get("codec_long_name"),
226	            "profile": s.get("profile"),
227	            "width": s.get("width"),
228	            "height": s.get("height"),
229	            "fps": _fps(s.get("avg_frame_rate"))
230	            if s.get("codec_type") == "video"
231	            else None,
232	            "pix_fmt": s.get("pix_fmt"),
233	            "color_range": s.get("color_range"),
234	            "color_space": s.get("color_space"),
235	            "bit_rate": _num(s.get("bit_rate")),
236	            "sample_rate": _num(s.get("sample_rate")),
237	            "channels": s.get("channels"),
238	            "channel_layout": s.get("channel_layout"),
239	            "language": s.get("tags", {}).get("language"),
240	            "handler": s.get("tags", {}).get("handler_name"),
241	            "duration_s": _num(s.get("duration")),
242	            "frames": _num(s.get("nb_frames")),
243	        }
244	        for s in probe.get("streams", [])
245	    ]
246	
247	    return {
248	        "sha256": sha256,
249	        "md5": md5,
250	        "ingested_at": case.created,
251	        "container": {
252	            "format_name": fmt.get("format_name"),
253	            "format_long_name": fmt.get("format_long_name"),
254	            "bit_rate": _num(fmt.get("bit_rate")),
255	            "size_bytes": _num(fmt.get("size")),
256	            "duration_s": _num(fmt.get("duration")),
257	        },
258	        "streams": streams,
259	        "tags": tags,
260	    }
261	
262	
263	async def _index(case: Case) -> None:
264	    # The files are the record of the run; a database hiccup must not sink it.
265	    try:
266	        await db.index_case(case)
267	    except (psycopg.Error, OSError) as error:
268	        case.emit(
269	            {"type": "log", "module": "index",
270	             "message": f"database index not updated: {type(error).__name__}: {error}"}
271	        )  # fmt: skip
272	
273	
274	async def run_case(case: Case, *, only: list[str] | None = None) -> None:
275	    case.status = "running"
276	    # Mark the case running in the index without holding up the analysis.
277	    started_index = asyncio.create_task(_index(case))
278	    ctx = CaseContext(case.id, case.evidence_path, case.workdir, case.options)
279	    case.ctx = ctx
280	    probe = await ctx.probe()
281	    info = await ctx.video_info()
282	    has_audio = any(s.get("codec_type") == "audio" for s in probe.get("streams", []))
283	    modules = [m for m in registry.all_modules() if only is None or m.name in only]
284	
285	    # Modules not scheduled in this run count as finished with nothing to say,
286	    # so anything waiting on them carries on immediately.
287	    for other in registry.all_modules():
288	        if other.name not in {m.name for m in modules}:
289	            ctx.publish(other.name, None)
290	    proxy_task = asyncio.create_task(_make_proxy(case))
291	    await _thumbnail(case)
292	    case.emit(
293	        {
294	            "type": "case",
295	            "case": {
296	                "id": case.id,
297	                "filename": case.filename,
298	                "duration_s": float(probe.get("format", {}).get("duration") or 0),
299	                "size_bytes": int(probe.get("format", {}).get("size") or 0),
300	                "has_audio": has_audio,
301	                "video": None
302	                if info is None
303	                else {
304	                    "width": info.width,
305	                    "height": info.height,
306	                    "fps": round(info.fps, 3),
307	                    "codec": info.codec,
308	                    "frames": info.frame_count,
309	                },
310	                "thumb_url": f"/api/cases/{case.id}/files/thumb.jpg",
311	                "media_url": None,
312	                **(await _custody(case, probe)),
313	                "modules": [
314	                    {"name": m.name, "title": m.title, "description": m.description}
315	                    for m in modules
316	                ],
317	            },
318	        }
319	    )
320	
321	    for module in modules:
322	        case.emit(
323	            {"type": "module", "module": module.name, "status": "queued", "progress": 0}
324	        )
325	
326	    # Heavy modules are numpy/OpenCV bound; a small limit keeps the UI lively.
327	    gate = asyncio.Semaphore(int(os.environ.get("EARWITNESS_PARALLEL", "4")))
328	
329	    async def one(module: Any) -> None:
330	        reporter = Reporter(module.name, ctx, case.emit)
331	        depends = list(getattr(module, "depends", ()))
332	
333	        if depends == ["*"]:
334	            depends = [m.name for m in modules if m.name != module.name]
335	
336	        if depends:
337	            case.emit(
338	                {"type": "module", "module": module.name, "status": "waiting",
339	                 "progress": 0, "message": "waiting for " + ", ".join(depends)}
340	            )  # fmt: skip
341	
342	        for dependency in depends:
343	            if any(m.name == dependency for m in modules):
344	                await ctx.wait_for(dependency)
345	
346	        started = time.time()
347	
348	        async with gate:
349	            case.emit(
350	                {
351	                    "type": "module",
352	                    "module": module.name,
353	                    "status": "running",
354	                    "progress": 0,
355	                }
356	            )
357	
358	            try:
359	                await module.run(ctx, reporter)
360	            except Skip as reason:
361	                ctx.publish(module.name, None)
362	                case.emit(
363	                    {"type": "module", "module": module.name, "status": "skipped",
364	                     "progress": 1, "message": str(reason)}
365	                )  # fmt: skip
366	
367	                return
368	            except asyncio.CancelledError:
369	                raise
370	            except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001 - one module must not sink the case
371	                ctx.publish(module.name, None)
372	                case.emit(
373	                    {"type": "module", "module": module.name, "status": "error",
374	                     "progress": 1, "message": f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}",
375	                     "trace": traceback.format_exc()[-2000:]}
376	                )  # fmt: skip
377	
378	                return
379	
380	        if module.name not in ctx._published:
381	            ctx.publish(module.name, None)
382	
383	        case.emit(
384	            {"type": "module", "module": module.name, "status": "done", "progress": 1,
385	             "elapsed_s": round(time.time() - started, 2)}
386	        )  # fmt: skip
387	
388	    async def proxy() -> None:
389	        path = await proxy_task
390	        case.emit(
391	            {
392	                "type": "media",
393	                "media_url": f"/api/cases/{case.id}/files/proxy.mp4" if path else None,
394	            }
395	        )
396	
397	    await asyncio.gather(proxy(), *(one(m) for m in modules))
398	    case.status = "done"
399	    await started_index
400	    await _index(case)
401	    case.emit({"type": "done"})
402

272	@app.websocket("/ws/cases/{case_id}")
273	async def stream(socket: WebSocket, case_id: str) -> None:
274	    case = store.cases.get(case_id)
275	    await socket.accept()
276	
277	    if case is None:
278	        await socket.send_json({"type": "error", "message": "no such case"})
279	        await socket.close()
280	
281	        return
282	
283	    queue: asyncio.Queue[dict[str, Any]] = asyncio.Queue()
284	    # Register before replaying so no event falls between the two.
285	    case.listeners.add(queue)
286	
287	    try:
288	        replay = list(case.events)
289	
290	        for event in replay:
291	            await socket.send_json(event)
292	
293	        seen = len(replay)
294	
295	        while True:
296	            event = await queue.get()
297	
298	            if event["type"] == "reset":
299	                seen = 0
300	                await socket.send_json(event)
301	
302	                continue
303	
304	            if event["seq"] < seen:
305	                continue
306	
307	            await socket.send_json(event)
308	    except WebSocketDisconnect:
309	        pass
310	    finally:
311	        case.listeners.discard(queue)

1	# EARWITNESS server ↔ UI protocol
2	
3	Backend: FastAPI (`uv run earwitness serve --port 8765`). In production the
4	built SPA (`web/dist`) is served by the same server at `/`. In dev, Vite proxies
5	`/api` and `/ws` to `http://127.0.0.1:8765`.
6	
7	## REST
8	
9	| Method | Path | Body / query | Returns |
10	|---|---|---|---|
11	| GET | `/api/health` | | `{ok, openai: bool, modules: [{name,title,description}]}` |
12	| GET | `/api/cases` | | `[CaseSummary]`, newest first (includes `verdict`, `summary_plain` once the brief exists) |
13	| POST | `/api/cases` | multipart `file`; optional query `approx_time` (ISO), `search_hours` | `CaseSummary` (analysis starts immediately) |
14	| POST | `/api/cases/from-path` | JSON `{path, options?}` (a file on the server machine) | `CaseSummary` |
15	| GET | `/api/cases/{id}` | | `{summary: CaseSummary, events: [Event]}` (full replay) |
16	| DELETE | `/api/cases/{id}` | | `{deleted}` |
17	| POST | `/api/cases/{id}/rerun` | | `CaseSummary` |
18	| GET | `/api/cases/{id}/files/{path}` | | artifact files (PNG/JPG/MP4); URLs arrive ready-made in events |
19	| POST | `/api/cases/{id}/enhance` | JSON `{time_s, x, y, w, h, frames?}`; x,y,w,h are 0..1 fractions of the video frame | `{single_url, enhanced_url, frames_used, scale, source_px:[w,h], time_s}` |
20	| GET | `/api/cases/{id}/report` | | printable HTML report (open in new tab) |
21	
22	`CaseSummary = {id, filename, created (unix s), status: queued|running|done|interrupted, findings, warnings, case: CaseInfo|null}`
23	
24	## WebSocket `/ws/cases/{id}`
25	
26	On connect the server replays every event so far, then streams new ones live.
27	Every event has `seq` (0-based, increasing) and `ts` (unix seconds) plus a `type`:
28	
29	### `case` (first event)
30	```json
31	{"type":"case","case":{"id":"…","filename":"IMG_6335.MOV","duration_s":23.1,"size_bytes":27607625,
32	 "has_audio":true,"video":{"width":1080,"height":1920,"fps":30.0,"codec":"hevc","frames":693}|null,
33	 "thumb_url":"/api/cases/…/files/thumb.jpg","media_url":null,
34	 "modules":[{"name":"provenance","title":"PROVENANCE","description":"…"}, …]}}
35	```
36	
37	Since the custody update, `case` also carries `sha256`, `md5`, `ingested_at` (unix s),
38	`container` {format_name, format_long_name, bit_rate, size_bytes, duration_s},
39	`streams` [{index, type, codec, codec_long, profile, width, height, fps, pix_fmt,
40	color_range, color_space, bit_rate, sample_rate, channels, channel_layout, language,
41	handler, duration_s, frames}] and `tags` (every container tag, plus stream tags as
42	`stream<N>.<key>`).
43	
44	### `media`
45	Browser-playable H.264 proxy of the evidence is ready (phones record HEVC/VP9):
46	`{"type":"media","media_url":"/api/cases/…/files/proxy.mp4"}` (or `null` if transcoding failed; fall back to nothing).
47	
48	### `module`, status updates per analysis module
49	`{"type":"module","module":"timeline","status":"queued|waiting|running|done|skipped|error","progress":0..1,"message":"decoding frames","elapsed_s"?:1.2,"trace"?:"…"}`
50	
51	### `finding`, the main payload
52	```json
53	{"type":"finding","finding":{
54	  "id":"F007","module":"spectrum","severity":"info|notice|warning|critical",
55	  "title":"Keypad tones decoded: 1984#","detail":"…one or two sentences…",
56	  "time_s":4.0|null,"time_end_s":null,
57	  "kind":"measured|inferred",          // inferred = AI (OpenAI) output, label it so
58	  "tags":["dtmf","audio"],              // e.g. splice, cut, location, gps, time, tone, ultrasonic, enf, face, pulse, text …
59	  "data":{…module-specific…}}}
60	```
61	Clicking a finding with `time_s` should seek the video there. Findings tagged
62	`location`/`gps` usually carry `data.lat/lon`.
63	
64	### `artifact`, things to visualise
65	`{"type":"artifact","artifact":{"id":"module:name","module":"…","name":"…","kind":"…","title":"…","url":string|null,"data":any,"time_s":number|null}}`
66	
67	An artifact with an id already seen replaces the old one. Kinds:
68	
69	| kind | payload | render as |
70	|---|---|---|
71	| `spectrogram` | `url` PNG (low freq at bottom); `data {t0,t1,f0,f1,scale:"linear"}` | image with time/freq axes; draw a playhead synced to the video |
72	| `series` | `data {x:[…], series:[{name, y:[…], x?:[…]}], x_unit?, y_unit?, marks?:{label: x}}` or `{x_iso:[…], series}` (ISO time x-axis). A series with its own `x` overrides the shared x. `marks` = labelled vertical reference lines | line chart; if `x_unit=="s"` draw playhead |
73	| `waveform` | `data {t1, peak:[0..1 …]}` | mirrored waveform strip on the timeline |
74	| `filmstrip` | `url` JPG sprite: `count` tiles side-by-side; `data {tile_width,tile_height,times:[…],count}` | thumbnail track on the timeline |
75	| `markers` | `data {times:[…], …}` | tick marks on the timeline |
76	| `table` | `data {rows:[[…]], columns?:[…]}` | monospace table |
77	| `bars` | `data {labels:[…], values:[…]}` | bar chart |
78	| `map` | `data {points:[{lat,lon,label,accuracy_m?,kind}]}` | dark map (Leaflet + CARTO dark tiles), accuracy circle |
79	| `image` / `heatmap` | `url`, optional `data {caption, time_s, overlay?:bool}` | gallery; heatmaps can overlay the video at `time_s` |
80	| `video` | `url` MP4 (e.g. pulse colour magnification) | player |
81	| `text` | `data {text}` | prose panel |
82	| `json` | `data` = any JSON (e.g. `provenance:probe`, the raw ffprobe report) | collapsible tree |
83	| `brief` | `data {verdict: "EDITED"\|"POSSIBLY EDITED"\|"NO SIGNS OF EDITING", bullets:[str], text, corroborated:bool, headline?, narrative?, next_steps?:[str], model?}`. Bullets start with WHEN:/WHERE:/DEVICE:/PEOPLE:/INTEGRITY:/HIDDEN:/CORROBORATED: and cite finding ids like `[F012]` (make those clickable → scroll to/highlight the finding). `headline`/`narrative` exist only when OpenAI is on (AI-inferred) | the ANALYST/verdict panel (id `brief:brief`) |
84	| `captions` | `data {segments:[{start,end,text}]}` | subtitles over the video at currentTime + transcript list |
85	
86	### `log`
87	`{"type":"log","module":"…","message":"…"}`, for a scrolling terminal feed.
88	
89	### `done`
90	All modules finished.

1	"""Pixel-level tampering cues on selected frames.
2	
3	- Error level analysis: re-compress the frame and see which regions change.
4	  Areas pasted in from elsewhere often recompress differently.
5	- Noise residual: every camera leaves a uniform grain; a region with
6	  noticeably different grain was processed separately (blurred, pasted,
7	  generated). Video codecs reshape grain too, so these maps are for an
8	  examiner's eye and are not turned into findings.
9	- Copy-move: identical keypoint patterns at two places in one frame (cloned
10	  objects or patched-over areas).
11	"""
12	
13	import asyncio
14	from typing import Any
15	
16	import cv2
17	import numpy as np
18	
19	from earwitness.modules.base import CaseContext
20	from earwitness.modules.base import Reporter
21	from earwitness.modules.base import Skip
22	
23	_WIDTH = 960
24	_BLOCK = 24
25	_SAMPLES = 6
26	
27	
28	def _heat(base: np.ndarray, heat: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
29	    heat = np.clip(heat, 0, 1)
30	    colour = cv2.applyColorMap((heat * 255).astype(np.uint8), cv2.COLORMAP_INFERNO)
31	    colour = cv2.resize(
32	        colour, (base.shape[1], base.shape[0]), interpolation=cv2.INTER_NEAREST
33	    )
34	    bgr = cv2.cvtColor(base, cv2.COLOR_RGB2BGR)
35	    alpha = cv2.resize(heat, (base.shape[1], base.shape[0]))[..., None] * 0.75
36	
37	    return (bgr * (1 - alpha) + colour * alpha).astype(np.uint8)
38	
39	
40	def _ela(frame: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
41	    bgr = cv2.cvtColor(frame, cv2.COLOR_RGB2BGR)
42	    _, encoded = cv2.imencode(".jpg", bgr, [cv2.IMWRITE_JPEG_QUALITY, 90])
43	    again = cv2.imdecode(encoded, cv2.IMREAD_COLOR)
44	    diff = (
45	        np.abs(bgr.astype(np.int16) - again.astype(np.int16))
46	        .max(axis=2)
47	        .astype(np.float32)
48	    )
49	
50	    return cv2.blur(diff, (5, 5))
51	
52	
53	def _blocks(values: np.ndarray, block: int) -> np.ndarray:
54	    h, w = values.shape[0] // block, values.shape[1] // block
55	
56	    return (
57	        values[: h * block, : w * block].reshape(h, block, w, block).mean(axis=(1, 3))
58	    )
59	
60	
61	def _noise_map(frame: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
62	    gray = cv2.cvtColor(frame, cv2.COLOR_RGB2GRAY).astype(np.float32)
63	    residual = gray - cv2.medianBlur(gray.astype(np.uint8), 3).astype(np.float32)
64	    energy = _blocks(np.abs(residual), _BLOCK)
65	    # Grain depends on brightness and texture; compare like with like.
66	    brightness = _blocks(gray, _BLOCK)
67	    texture = _blocks(
68	        np.abs(cv2.Laplacian(cv2.GaussianBlur(gray, (0, 0), 2), cv2.CV_32F)), _BLOCK
69	    )
70	    design = np.stack(
71	        [
72	            np.ones_like(brightness),
73	            brightness / 255,
74	            (brightness / 255) ** 2,
75	            np.log1p(texture),
76	        ],
77	        axis=-1,
78	    )
79	    flat_design = design.reshape(-1, design.shape[-1])
80	    target = np.log1p(energy.reshape(-1))
81	    coeffs, *_ = np.linalg.lstsq(flat_design, target, rcond=None)
82	    residual_map = (target - flat_design @ coeffs).reshape(energy.shape)
83	    mad = np.median(np.abs(residual_map - np.median(residual_map))) * 1.4826 + 1e-6
84	    # Ignore saturated / black blocks: no grain there anyway.
85	    valid = (brightness > 12) & (brightness < 243)
86	
87	    return np.where(valid, (residual_map - np.median(residual_map)) / mad, 0.0)
88	
89	
90	def _copy_move(
91	    frame: np.ndarray,
92	) -> tuple[list[tuple[tuple[int, int], tuple[int, int]]], tuple[int, int] | None]:
93	    gray = cv2.cvtColor(frame, cv2.COLOR_RGB2GRAY)
94	    orb = cv2.ORB_create(nfeatures=3000, fastThreshold=12)
95	    keypoints, descriptors = orb.detectAndCompute(gray, None)
96	
97	    if descriptors is None or len(keypoints) < 50:
98	        return [], None
99	
100	    matcher = cv2.BFMatcher(cv2.NORM_HAMMING)
101	    matches = matcher.knnMatch(descriptors, descriptors, k=3)
102	    pairs = []
103	
104	    for group in matches:
105	        for match in group[1:]:
106	            if match.distance > 32:
107	                continue
108	
109	            a = np.array(keypoints[match.queryIdx].pt)
110	            b = np.array(keypoints[match.trainIdx].pt)
111	
112	            if np.linalg.norm(a - b) > 40:
113	                pairs.append((a, b))
114	
115	    if len(pairs) < 10:
116	        return [], None
117	
118	    offsets = np.array([np.round((b - a) / 6) for a, b in pairs]).astype(int)
119	    keys, counts = np.unique(offsets, axis=0, return_counts=True)
120	    best = int(np.argmax(counts))
121	
122	    if counts[best] < 14:
123	        return [], None
124	
125	    offset = keys[best]
126	    # A pasted clone puts nearly all self-matches on one offset (and its mirror).
127	    # Repeated real objects (lamps, windows, keys, tiles) match at many offsets.
128	    mirror = np.all(keys == -offset, axis=1)
129	    on_offset = counts[best] + (counts[mirror].sum() if mirror.any() else 0)
130	
131	    if on_offset < 0.5 * len(pairs):
132	        return [], None
133	    chosen = [
134	        (tuple(map(int, a)), tuple(map(int, b)))
135	        for (a, b), o in zip(pairs, offsets)
136	        if np.abs(o - offset).max() <= 1
137	    ]
138	    sources = np.array([c[0] for c in chosen])
139	    # Repetitive texture (tiles, windows, text) repeats at many offsets; a clone
140	    # is one compact patch moved once.
141	    spread = np.ptp(sources, axis=0)
142	
143	    if spread.max() > 0.5 * max(frame.shape[:2]) or len(chosen) < 14:
144	        return [], None
145	
146	    return chosen, (int(offset[0] * 6), int(offset[1] * 6))
147	
148	
149	def _analyse(frame: np.ndarray) -> dict[str, Any]:
150	    ela = _ela(frame)
151	    ela_blocks = _blocks(ela, _BLOCK)
152	    ela_z = (ela_blocks - np.median(ela_blocks)) / (
153	        np.median(np.abs(ela_blocks - np.median(ela_blocks))) * 1.4826 + 1e-6
154	    )
155	    noise_z = _noise_map(frame)
156	    pairs, offset = _copy_move(frame)
157	    noise_hot = np.abs(noise_z) > 4.5
158	    # Only clustered anomalies matter; isolated blocks are texture.
159	    count, labels, stats, _ = cv2.connectedComponentsWithStats(
160	        noise_hot.astype(np.uint8), connectivity=8
161	    )
162	    regions = [
163	        {
164	            "x": int(s[0]) * _BLOCK,
165	            "y": int(s[1]) * _BLOCK,
166	            "w": int(s[2]) * _BLOCK,
167	            "h": int(s[3]) * _BLOCK,
168	            "blocks": int(s[4]),
169	        }
170	        for s in stats[1:]
171	        if s[4] >= 6
172	    ]
173	
174	    return {
175	        "ela": ela,
176	        "ela_z": ela_z,
177	        "noise_z": noise_z,
178	        "regions": sorted(regions, key=lambda r: -r["blocks"]),
179	        "noise_fraction": float(noise_hot.mean()),
180	        "copy_move": pairs,
181	        "copy_offset": offset,
182	    }
183	
184	
185	class Tamper:
186	    name = "tamper"
187	    title = "PIXEL FORENSICS"
188	    description = "Error-level analysis, noise-residual consistency and copy-move detection on key frames."
189	    depends = ["timeline"]
190	
191	    async def run(self, ctx: CaseContext, out: Reporter) -> None:
192	        info = await ctx.video_info()
193	
194	        if info is None:
195	            raise Skip("no video stream")
196	
197	        timeline = await ctx.wait_for("timeline") or {}
198	        duration = max(info.duration_s, 0.1)
199	        times = list(np.linspace(0.5, max(0.5, duration - 0.5), _SAMPLES))
200	
201	        for cut in (timeline.get("cuts") or [])[:4]:
202	            times += [max(0.0, cut - 0.2), cut + 0.2]
203	
204	        times = sorted({round(t, 2) for t in times})
205	        width = min(_WIDTH, info.width)
206	        flagged = 0
207	        published: dict[str, Any] = {"frames": []}
208	
209	        for number, time_s in enumerate(times):
210	            out.progress(0.05 + 0.9 * number / len(times), f"frame @ {time_s:.2f}s")
211	            frame = await ctx.frame_at(time_s, width=width)
212	
213	            if frame is None:
214	                continue
215	
216	            result = await asyncio.to_thread(_analyse, frame)
217	            noise_heat = np.clip(np.abs(result["noise_z"]) / 8, 0, 1).astype(np.float32)
218	            ela_heat = np.clip(
219	                result["ela"] / (np.percentile(result["ela"], 99.5) + 1e-6), 0, 1
220	            ).astype(np.float32)
221	            stem = f"{number:02d}_{time_s:07.2f}"
222	            noise_path = out.path(f"noise_{stem}.jpg")
223	            ela_path = out.path(f"ela_{stem}.jpg")
224	            cv2.imwrite(
225	                noise_path, _heat(frame, noise_heat), [cv2.IMWRITE_JPEG_QUALITY, 85]
226	            )
227	            cv2.imwrite(
228	                ela_path, _heat(frame, ela_heat), [cv2.IMWRITE_JPEG_QUALITY, 85]
229	            )
230	            out.artifact(
231	                f"noise_{stem}", "heatmap", f"Noise-residual map @ {time_s:.2f}s",
232	                file=noise_path, time_s=time_s, data={"caption": "bright = grain unlike the rest of the frame"},
233	            )  # fmt: skip
234	            out.artifact(
235	                f"ela_{stem}", "heatmap", f"Error-level analysis @ {time_s:.2f}s",
236	                file=ela_path, time_s=time_s, data={"caption": "bright = recompresses differently"},
237	            )  # fmt: skip
238	            published["frames"].append(
239	                {
240	                    "time_s": time_s,
241	                    "regions": result["regions"][:5],
242	                    "noise_fraction": result["noise_fraction"],
243	                }
244	            )
245	
246	            if result["copy_move"]:
247	                flagged += 1
248	                image = cv2.cvtColor(frame, cv2.COLOR_RGB2BGR).copy()
249	
250	                for a, b in result["copy_move"][:150]:
251	                    cv2.line(image, a, b, (80, 220, 255), 1, cv2.LINE_AA)
252	                    cv2.circle(image, a, 3, (60, 60, 255), -1)
253	                    cv2.circle(image, b, 3, (60, 255, 120), -1)
254	
255	                path = out.path(f"clone_{stem}.jpg")
256	                cv2.imwrite(path, image)
257	                out.artifact(
258	                    f"clone_{stem}",
259	                    "image",
260	                    f"Copy-move matches @ {time_s:.2f}s",
261	                    file=path,
262	                    time_s=time_s,
263	                )
264	                out.finding(
265	                    "warning",
266	                    f"Cloned region @ {time_s:.2f}s",
267	                    f"{len(result['copy_move'])} identical feature points repeat at a fixed offset "
268	                    f"{result['copy_offset']} px within one frame. Cloning stamps one area over another "
269	                    "to hide or duplicate something. Repetitive real patterns can also do this.",
270	                    time_s=time_s,
271	                    tags=["tamper", "clone"],
272	                    data={
273	                        "offset": result["copy_offset"],
274	                        "matches": len(result["copy_move"]),
275	                    },
276	                )
277	
278	        if not flagged:
279	            out.finding(
280	                "info",
281	                f"No cloned regions in {len(times)} sampled frames",
282	                "No patch of any sampled frame reappears elsewhere in the same frame. Error-level "
283	                "and grain heatmaps are attached for visual inspection; on phone video, compression "
284	                "itself shapes them, so they are not scored automatically.",
285	                tags=["tamper"],
286	            )
287	
288	        ctx.publish(self.name, published)
289	        out.progress(1.0)

7	import asyncio

9	import os

11	import struct

13	from datetime import timedelta

22	_ISO6709 = re.compile(r"([+-]\d+(?:\.\d+)?)([+-]\d+(?:\.\d+)?)([+-]\d+(?:\.\d+)?)?")
23	_FILENAME_TIME = re.compile(r"(20\d{2})(\d{2})(\d{2})[_-]?(\d{2})(\d{2})(\d{2})")
24	_CONTAINER_BOXES = {
25	    b"moov",
26	    b"trak",
27	    b"mdia",
28	    b"minf",
29	    b"stbl",
30	    b"udta",
31	    b"edts",
32	    b"dinf",
33	}

35	# Software fingerprints in tags / handler names.
36	_SIGNATURES = [
37	    (re.compile(r"lavf|libavformat", re.I), "FFmpeg (libavformat)", "editor"),
38	    (re.compile(r"handbrake", re.I), "HandBrake", "editor"),
39	    (re.compile(r"premiere|adobe", re.I), "Adobe software", "editor"),
40	    (re.compile(r"capcut|bytedance", re.I), "CapCut / ByteDance", "editor"),
41	    (re.compile(r"davinci|resolve", re.I), "DaVinci Resolve", "editor"),
42	    (re.compile(r"imovie|final cut", re.I), "Apple iMovie / Final Cut", "editor"),
43	    (re.compile(r"whatsapp", re.I), "WhatsApp", "social"),
44	    (re.compile(r"telegram", re.I), "Telegram", "social"),
45	    (re.compile(r"google", re.I), "Google (Photos/Android)", "platform"),
46	    (re.compile(r"core media", re.I), "Apple Core Media (camera)", "camera"),

49	
50	def _boxes(
51	    path: str, start: int = 0, end: int | None = None, depth: int = 0
52	) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
53	    """Walk the ISO-BMFF box tree (top level and the usual containers)."""
54	    out: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
55	    end = end if end is not None else os.path.getsize(path)
56	
57	    with open(path, "rb") as handle:
58	        offset = start
59	
60	        while offset + 8 <= end and len(out) < 400:
61	            handle.seek(offset)
62	            header = handle.read(16)
63	
64	            if len(header) < 8:
65	                break
66	
67	            size, kind = struct.unpack(">I4s", header[:8])
68	            header_len = 8
69	
70	            if size == 1 and len(header) >= 16:
71	                size = struct.unpack(">Q", header[8:16])[0]
72	                header_len = 16
73	            elif size == 0:
74	                size = end - offset
75	
76	            if size < header_len or not re.fullmatch(rb"[ -~]{4}", kind):
77	                break
78	
79	            box = {
80	                "type": kind.decode("latin-1"),
81	                "offset": offset,
82	                "size": size,
83	                "depth": depth,
84	            }
85	            out.append(box)
86	
87	            if kind in _CONTAINER_BOXES and depth < 4:
88	                out.extend(_boxes(path, offset + header_len, offset + size, depth + 1))
89	
90	            offset += size
91	
92	    return out
93	
94	
95	def _parse_time(value: str | None) -> datetime | None:
96	    if not value:
97	        return None
98	
99	    text = value.strip().replace("Z", "+00:00")
100	
101	    # QuickTime writes "+0000" without a colon.
102	    text = re.sub(r"([+-]\d{2})(\d{2})$", r"\1:\2", text)
103	
104	    try:
105	        parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(text)
106	    except ValueError:
107	        return None
108	
109	    return parsed if parsed.tzinfo else parsed.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
110	
111	
112	def sun_position(
113	    when: datetime, latitude: float, longitude: float
114	) -> tuple[float, float]:
115	    """Solar elevation and azimuth in degrees (NOAA approximation, ~0.5°)."""
116	    utc = when.astimezone(timezone.utc)
117	    day = utc.timetuple().tm_yday
118	    hour = utc.hour + utc.minute / 60 + utc.second / 3600
119	    gamma = 2 * math.pi / 365 * (day - 1 + (hour - 12) / 24)
120	    equation = 229.18 * (
121	        0.000075 + 0.001868 * math.cos(gamma) - 0.032077 * math.sin(gamma)
122	        - 0.014615 * math.cos(2 * gamma) - 0.040849 * math.sin(2 * gamma)
123	    )  # fmt: skip
124	    declination = (
125	        0.006918 - 0.399912 * math.cos(gamma) + 0.070257 * math.sin(gamma)
126	        - 0.006758 * math.cos(2 * gamma) + 0.000907 * math.sin(2 * gamma)
127	        - 0.002697 * math.cos(3 * gamma) + 0.00148 * math.sin(3 * gamma)
128	    )  # fmt: skip
129	    true_solar = hour * 60 + equation + 4 * longitude
130	    hour_angle = math.radians(true_solar / 4 - 180)
131	    lat = math.radians(latitude)
132	    cos_zenith = math.sin(lat) * math.sin(declination) + math.cos(lat) * math.cos(
133	        declination
134	    ) * math.cos(hour_angle)
135	    zenith = math.acos(max(-1.0, min(1.0, cos_zenith)))
136	    elevation = 90 - math.degrees(zenith)
137	    azimuth = math.degrees(
138	        math.atan2(
139	            math.sin(hour_angle),
140	            math.cos(hour_angle) * math.sin(lat)
141	            - math.tan(declination) * math.cos(lat),
142	        )
143	    )
144	
145	    return elevation, (azimuth + 180) % 360

148	async def _reverse_geocode(latitude: float, longitude: float) -> str | None:
149	    if os.environ.get("EARWITNESS_OFFLINE"):
150	        return None
151	
152	    try:
153	        async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=6.0) as client:
154	            response = await client.get(
155	                "https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/reverse",
156	                params={
157	                    "lat": latitude,
158	                    "lon": longitude,
159	                    "format": "jsonv2",
160	                    "zoom": 17,
161	                },
162	                headers={"User-Agent": "earwitness-forensics/0.1"},
163	            )
164	
165	        if response.status_code != 200:
166	            return None
167	
168	        return response.json().get("display_name")
169	    except httpx.HTTPError, ValueError:
170	        return None

51	) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
52	    """The case in plain English: one question per card, with a confidence word."""
53	    by_title = lambda *prefixes: [f for f in findings if f.title.startswith(prefixes)]  # noqa: E731
54	    answers = []
55	
56	    # ---- edited? ----------------------------------------------------------
57	    edits = [
58	        f
59	        for f in findings
60	        if f.kind == "measured"
61	        and f.severity in ("warning", "critical")
62	        and ({"splice", "cut", "clone", "sync"} & set(f.tags))
63	    ]
64	    software = [f for f in findings if "editor" in f.tags]

67	        (f for f in edits if f.time_s is not None), key=lambda f: f.time_s, default=None
68	    )

71	
72	    if corroborated:
73	        at = corroborated[0].time_s
74	        others = [
75	            f
76	            for f in edits
77	            if f.time_s is not None and at is not None and abs(f.time_s - at) > 1.5
78	        ]

80	
81	        if others:

84	                f"spot{'s' if len(others) > 1 else ''}, first at {_clock(min(f.time_s for f in others))}."
85	            )

523	def _local_brief(findings: list[Finding]) -> dict[str, Any]:
524	    serious = [
525	        f
526	        for f in findings
527	        if f.severity in ("warning", "critical") and f.kind == "measured"
528	    ]
529	    edits = [f for f in serious if _EDIT_TAGS & set(f.tags)]
530	    software = [f for f in serious if "editor" in f.tags]
531	    independent_modules = {f.module for f in edits}
532	
533	    hard_cuts = [f for f in edits if "cut" in f.tags]
534	
535	    if (
536	        len(independent_modules) >= 2
537	        or any(f.severity == "critical" for f in edits)
538	        or hard_cuts
539	    ):
540	        verdict = "EDITED"
541	    elif edits or software:
542	        verdict = "POSSIBLY EDITED"
543	    else:
544	        verdict = "NO SIGNS OF EDITING"
545	
546	    bullets: list[str] = []
547	    when = _with(findings, "enf") and [
548	        f
549	        for f in _with(findings, "enf", "time")
550	        if f.title.startswith(("ENF dates", "Lighting dates"))
551	    ]
552	    container = [f for f in findings if f.title.startswith("Container clock")]
553	
554	    if when:
555	        bullets.append(f"WHEN: {when[0].title} [{when[0].id}]")
556	    elif container:
557	        bullets.append(
558	            f"WHEN: {container[0].title}, from metadata only, not independently verified [{container[0].id}]"
559	        )
560	    else:
561	        bullets.append("WHEN: no time evidence in the file")
562	
563	    gps = _with(findings, "gps")
564	    postcode = [f for f in _with(findings, "text") if "postcode" in f.title.lower()]
565	    grid = [
566	        f
567	        for f in findings
568	        if ("flicker" in f.tags or "enf" in f.tags)
569	        and "grid" in f.title.lower()
570	        and f.severity == "critical"
571	    ]
572	    place_bits = []
573	
574	    if gps:
575	        place_bits.append(f"{gps[0].title} [{gps[0].id}]")
576	
577	    if postcode:
578	        place_bits.append(f"{postcode[0].title} [{postcode[0].id}]")
579	
580	    if grid:
581	        place_bits.append(f"{grid[0].title} [{grid[0].id}]")
582	
583	    inferred_place = [
584	        f for f in findings if f.kind == "inferred" and "location" in f.tags
585	    ]
586	
587	    if inferred_place:
588	        place_bits.append(f"AI: {inferred_place[0].title} [{inferred_place[0].id}]")
589	
590	    bullets.append(
591	        "WHERE: " + ("; ".join(place_bits) if place_bits else "no location evidence")
592	    )
593	    device = _with(findings, "device")
594	    people = [f for f in _with(findings, "pulse") if "bpm" in f.title]
595	
596	    if device:
597	        bullets.append(f"DEVICE: {device[0].title} [{device[0].id}]")
598	
599	    if people:
600	        bullets.append(
601	            "PEOPLE: " + "; ".join(f"{f.title} [{f.id}]" for f in people[:3])
602	        )
603	
604	    if edits or software:
605	        bullets.append(
606	            "INTEGRITY: "
607	            + "; ".join(f"{f.title} [{f.id}]" for f in (edits + software)[:6])
608	        )
609	    else:
610	        bullets.append(
611	            "INTEGRITY: frame clock, keyframes, audio continuity and pixels show no edit"
612	        )
613	
614	    hidden = [
615	        f
616	        for f in findings
617	        if {"dtmf", "ultrasonic", "tone", "doppler"} & set(f.tags)
618	        and f.severity != "info"
619	    ]
620	
621	    if hidden:
622	        bullets.append(
623	            "HIDDEN: " + "; ".join(f"{f.title} [{f.id}]" for f in hidden[:4])
624	        )
625	
626	    # Corroboration: an edit seen by two independent senses is much stronger.
627	    cut_times = [
628	        f.time_s for f in edits if f.time_s is not None and f.module == "timeline"
629	    ]
630	    audio_times = [
631	        f.time_s
632	        for f in edits
633	        if f.time_s is not None and f.module in ("spectrum", "enf")
634	    ]
635	    agreements = [(v, a) for v in cut_times for a in audio_times if abs(v - a) <= 1.5]
636	
637	    if agreements:
638	        v, a = agreements[0]
639	        bullets.append(
640	            f"CORROBORATED: picture cut at {v:.1f}s and audio break at {a:.1f}s coincide"
641	        )
642	
643	    text = f"VERDICT: {verdict}.\n" + "\n".join(bullets)
644	
645	    return {
646	        "verdict": verdict,
647	        "bullets": bullets,
648	        "text": text,
649	        "corroborated": bool(agreements),
650	        "corroborated_at": agreements[0][0] if agreements else None,
651	    }

785	                    ),
