1	"""What an analyst would notice in the frames (OpenAI vision, optional).
2	
3	Keyframes go to a vision model with a strict JSON schema: setting, likely
4	region and its visual evidence, time of day, notable observations, and any
5	visual signs of manipulation. Everything it says is labelled AI-inferred.
6	"""
7	
8	import base64
9	
10	import cv2
11	import numpy as np
12	
13	from earwitness import openai_client
14	from earwitness.modules.base import CaseContext
15	from earwitness.modules.base import Reporter
16	from earwitness.modules.base import Skip
17	
18	_FRAMES = 6
19	
20	_SCHEMA = {
21	    "type": "object",
22	    "additionalProperties": False,
23	    "required": [
24	        "scene",
25	        "setting",
26	        "location",
27	        "time_of_day",
28	        "weather",
29	        "observations",
30	        "manipulation_signs",
31	    ],
32	    "properties": {
33	        "scene": {
34	            "type": "string",
35	            "description": "One or two sentences: what the footage shows.",
36	        },
37	        "setting": {
38	            "type": "string",
39	            "enum": ["indoor", "outdoor", "vehicle", "mixed", "unknown"],
40	        },
41	        "location": {
42	            "type": "object",
43	            "additionalProperties": False,
44	            "required": [
45	                "guess",
46	                "confidence",
47	                "evidence",
48	                "latitude",
49	                "longitude",
50	                "radius_km",
51	            ],
52	            "properties": {
53	                "latitude": {
54	                    "type": "number",
55	                    "description": "Best-estimate latitude (0 if unknown).",
56	                },
57	                "longitude": {
58	                    "type": "number",
59	                    "description": "Best-estimate longitude (0 if unknown).",
60	                },
61	                "radius_km": {
62	                    "type": "number",
63	                    "description": "Honest ~80% radius; 20000 if the place is unknown.",
64	                },
65	                "guess": {
66	                    "type": "string",
67	                    "description": "Most specific defensible place (country/city/venue), or 'unknown'.",
68	                },
69	                "confidence": {"type": "string", "enum": ["low", "medium", "high"]},
70	                "evidence": {
71	                    "type": "array",
72	                    "items": {"type": "string"},
73	                    "description": "Visual clues: signage language, plugs, plates, architecture, vegetation, road markings…",
74	                },
75	            },
76	        },
77	        "time_of_day": {
78	            "type": "object",
79	            "additionalProperties": False,
80	            "required": ["guess", "evidence"],
81	            "properties": {"guess": {"type": "string"}, "evidence": {"type": "string"}},
82	        },
83	        "weather": {"type": "string"},
84	        "observations": {
85	            "type": "array",
86	            "maxItems": 8,
87	            "items": {
88	                "type": "object",
89	                "additionalProperties": False,
90	                "required": ["frame", "category", "description", "significance"],
91	                "properties": {
92	                    "frame": {"type": "integer"},
93	                    "category": {
94	                        "type": "string",
95	                        "enum": [
96	                            "text",
97	                            "landmark",
98	                            "vehicle",
99	                            "person",
100	                            "object",
101	                            "screen",
102	                            "reflection",
103	                            "anomaly",
104	                        ],
105	                    },
106	                    "description": {"type": "string"},
107	                    "significance": {
108	                        "type": "string",
109	                        "description": "Why an investigator would care.",
110	                    },
111	                },
112	            },
113	        },
114	        "manipulation_signs": {
115	            "type": "array",
116	            "items": {
117	                "type": "object",
118	                "additionalProperties": False,
119	                "required": ["frame", "description"],
120	                "properties": {
121	                    "frame": {"type": "integer"},
122	                    "description": {"type": "string"},
123	                },
124	            },
125	        },
126	    },
127	}
128	
129	_INSTRUCTIONS = (
130	    "You are a careful open-source-intelligence and video forensics analyst. You receive numbered "
131	    "keyframes from one video. Report only what is visible; never invent text you cannot read. Prefer "
132	    "'unknown' over guessing. Location clues: signage language and fonts, plug sockets, licence plates, "
133	    "road markings and driving side, architecture, vegetation, shop brands, weather and sun. Look for "
134	    "reflections (windows, glasses, screens) that reveal what is off-camera. Note manipulation signs only "
135	    "if concrete (warped background near a face, inconsistent shadows, mismatched lighting, cloned "
136	    "texture, impossible geometry)."
137	)
138	
139	
140	class Vision:
141	    name = "vision"
142	    title = "AI VISUAL ANALYST"
143	    description = "Keyframes read by a vision model: place, time of day, notable details, manipulation signs (optional)."
144	    depends = ["timeline"]
145	
146	    async def run(self, ctx: CaseContext, out: Reporter) -> None:
147	        if not openai_client.enabled():
148	            raise Skip("set OPENAI_API_KEY to enable")
149	
150	        info = await ctx.video_info()
151	
152	        if info is None:
153	            raise Skip("no video stream")
154	
155	        timeline = await ctx.wait_for("timeline") or {}
156	        times = list(np.linspace(0.3, max(0.3, info.duration_s - 0.3), _FRAMES))
157	
158	        for cut in (timeline.get("cuts") or [])[:3]:
159	            times.append(cut + 0.3)
160	
161	        times = sorted({round(t, 2) for t in times})[: _FRAMES + 2]
162	        content = [
163	            {
164	                "type": "input_text",
165	                "text": f"{len(times)} keyframes follow, numbered from 1 in time order.",
166	            }
167	        ]
168	        out.progress(0.1, "grabbing keyframes")
169	
170	        for number, time_s in enumerate(times, start=1):
171	            frame = await ctx.frame_at(time_s, width=min(1024, info.width))
172	
173	            if frame is None:
174	                continue
175	
176	            _, jpeg = cv2.imencode(
177	                ".jpg",
178	                cv2.cvtColor(frame, cv2.COLOR_RGB2BGR),
179	                [cv2.IMWRITE_JPEG_QUALITY, 82],
180	            )
181	            content.append(
182	                {"type": "input_text", "text": f"Frame {number} at {time_s:.1f} s:"}
183	            )
184	            content.append(
185	                {
186	                    "type": "input_image",
187	                    "image_url": "data:image/jpeg;base64,"
188	                    + base64.b64encode(jpeg.tobytes()).decode(),
189	                }
190	            )
191	
192	        out.progress(0.3, "consulting vision model")
193	        result = await openai_client.structured(
194	            ctx.workdir,
195	            instructions=_INSTRUCTIONS,
196	            content=content,
197	            schema=_SCHEMA,
198	            name="visual_report",
199	        )
200	        frame_time = {i: t for i, t in enumerate(times, start=1)}
201	        model = result.get("_model", "model")
202	        out.artifact(
203	            "report",
204	            "text",
205	            f"Visual analyst ({model})",
206	            data={"text": result["scene"]},
207	        )
208	        out.finding(
209	            "info",
210	            f"Scene: {result['setting']}",
211	            result["scene"]
212	            + (
213	                f" Weather: {result['weather']}."
214	                if result.get("weather") and result["weather"].lower() != "unknown"
215	                else ""
216	            ),
217	            kind="inferred",
218	            tags=["scene"],
219	        )
220	        location = result["location"]
221	
222	        if location["guess"].lower() != "unknown":
223	            out.finding(
224	                "notice",
225	                f"Looks like: {location['guess']} ({location['confidence']} confidence)",
226	                "Visual clues: " + "; ".join(location["evidence"][:6]) + ".",
227	                kind="inferred",
228	                tags=["location"],
229	                data=location,
230	            )
231	
232	        if result["time_of_day"]["guess"].lower() != "unknown":
233	            out.finding(
234	                "info",
235	                f"Time of day: {result['time_of_day']['guess']}",
236	                result["time_of_day"]["evidence"],
237	                kind="inferred",
238	                tags=["time"],
239	            )
240	
241	        for item in result["observations"][:5]:
242	            out.finding(
243	                "info",
244	                f"{item['category'].capitalize()}: {item['description'][:80]}",
245	                f"{item['description']} {item['significance']}",
246	                time_s=frame_time.get(item["frame"]),
247	                kind="inferred",
248	                tags=["observation", item["category"]],
249	            )
250	
251	        for sign in result["manipulation_signs"][:5]:
252	            out.finding(
253	                "warning",
254	                "Possible visual manipulation",
255	                sign["description"],
256	                time_s=frame_time.get(sign["frame"]),
257	                kind="inferred",
258	                tags=["tamper"],
259	            )
260	
261	        ctx.publish(self.name, result)
262	        out.progress(1.0)
263

1	"""Text in the picture (local OCR with Tesseract).
2	
3	Signs, screens, plates, receipts and clocks in the background say where and
4	when something was filmed. Each sampled frame is contrast-enhanced and
5	upscaled before recognition; the recognised words are then checked for
6	patterns that matter: UK postcodes, number plates, phone numbers, web
7	addresses, dates and clock times.
8	"""
9	
10	import asyncio
11	import csv
12	import io
13	import re
14	import shutil
15	from typing import Any
16	
17	import cv2
18	import numpy as np
19	
20	from earwitness.modules.base import CaseContext
21	from earwitness.modules.base import Reporter
22	from earwitness.modules.base import Skip
23	from earwitness.modules.base import run_tool
24	
25	_FRAMES = 14
26	_MIN_CONF = 75
27	
28	_PATTERNS = [
29	    (
30	        "postcode",
31	        re.compile(r"\b([A-Z]{1,2}\d[A-Z\d]?\s*\d[A-Z]{2})\b"),
32	        "UK postcode",
33	        "location",
34	    ),
35	    (
36	        "plate",
37	        re.compile(r"\b([A-Z]{2}\d{2}\s?[A-Z]{3})\b"),
38	        "UK number plate",
39	        "vehicle",
40	    ),
41	    (
42	        "phone",
43	        # UK-style (0xx / +44) or international (+cc) numbers, 10-13 digits.
44	        re.compile(
45	            r"(?<![\d])((?:\+\d{1,3}[\s-]?|0)\d{2,4}[\s-]?\d{3,4}[\s-]?\d{3,4})(?![\d])"
46	        ),
47	        "phone number",
48	        "contact",
49	    ),
50	    (
51	        "url",
52	        re.compile(
53	            r"\b((?:https?://|www\.)[\w.-]+\.[a-z]{2,}\S*|[\w-]+\.(?:com|co\.uk|org|net|io|ac\.uk|gov\.uk|ed\.ac\.uk))\b",
54	            re.I,
55	        ),
56	        "web address",
57	        "contact",
58	    ),
59	    ("email", re.compile(r"\b[\w.+-]+@[\w-]+\.[\w.]+\b"), "email address", "contact"),
60	    (
61	        "date",
62	        re.compile(r"\b(\d{1,2}[/.-]\d{1,2}[/.-](?:\d{2}|\d{4})|\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})\b"),
63	        "date",
64	        "time",
65	    ),
66	    (
67	        "clock",
68	        re.compile(r"\b([01]?\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\d(?::[0-5]\d)?\b"),
69	        "clock time",
70	        "time",
71	    ),
72	]
73	
74	
75	def _prepare(frame: np.ndarray) -> bytes:
76	    gray = cv2.cvtColor(frame, cv2.COLOR_RGB2GRAY)
77	    gray = cv2.resize(gray, None, fx=1.6, fy=1.6, interpolation=cv2.INTER_CUBIC)
78	    gray = cv2.createCLAHE(clipLimit=2.5, tileGridSize=(8, 8)).apply(gray)
79	    _, encoded = cv2.imencode(".png", gray)
80	
81	    return encoded.tobytes()
82	
83	
84	def _words(tsv: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
85	    rows = list(
86	        csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(tsv), delimiter="\t", quoting=csv.QUOTE_NONE)
87	    )
88	    words = []
89	
90	    for row in rows:
91	        text = (row.get("text") or "").strip()
92	
93	        try:
94	            conf = float(row.get("conf") or -1)
95	        except ValueError:
96	            continue
97	
98	        if conf < _MIN_CONF or len(text) < 2 or not re.search(r"[A-Za-z0-9]", text):
99	            continue
100	
101	        # Reject OCR confetti: mostly punctuation or one repeated character.
102	        if (
103	            sum(c.isalnum() for c in text) < 0.6 * len(text)
104	            or len(set(text.lower())) == 1
105	        ):
106	            continue
107	
108	        words.append(
109	            {
110	                "text": text,
111	                "conf": conf,
112	                "line": (row.get("block_num"), row.get("par_num"), row.get("line_num")),
113	                "box": [
114	                    int(row["left"]),
115	                    int(row["top"]),
116	                    int(row["width"]),
117	                    int(row["height"]),
118	                ],
119	            }
120	        )
121	
122	    return words
123	
124	
125	def _lines(words: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> list[str]:
126	    grouped: dict[Any, list[str]] = {}
127	
128	    for word in words:
129	        grouped.setdefault(word["line"], []).append(word["text"])
130	
131	    return [" ".join(parts) for parts in grouped.values() if len(" ".join(parts)) >= 3]
132	
133	
134	class Ocr:
135	    name = "ocr"
136	    title = "TEXT IN FRAME (OCR)"
137	    description = "Reads signs, screens and plates with Tesseract; flags postcodes, plates, phones, URLs, dates."
138	    depends = ["timeline"]
139	
140	    async def run(self, ctx: CaseContext, out: Reporter) -> None:
141	        if shutil.which("tesseract") is None:
142	            raise Skip("tesseract not installed")
143	
144	        info = await ctx.video_info()
145	
146	        if info is None:
147	            raise Skip("no video stream")
148	
149	        timeline = await ctx.wait_for("timeline") or {}
150	        times = list(np.linspace(0.3, max(0.3, info.duration_s - 0.3), _FRAMES))
151	        times += [c + 0.3 for c in (timeline.get("cuts") or [])[:6]]
152	        times = sorted({round(t, 2) for t in times})
153	        seen: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
154	        width = min(1600, info.width)
155	
156	        for number, time_s in enumerate(times):
157	            out.progress(number / len(times), f"reading frame @ {time_s:.1f}s")
158	            frame = await ctx.frame_at(time_s, width=width)
159	
160	            if frame is None:
161	                continue
162	
163	            image = await asyncio.to_thread(_prepare, frame)
164	            found_lines: list[str] = []
165	
166	            # Sparse mode catches scattered signs; automatic layout catches blocks
167	            # such as plates and labels that sparse mode skips.
168	            for psm in ("11", "3"):
169	                tsv = await run_tool(
170	                    "tesseract",
171	                    "stdin",
172	                    "stdout",
173	                    "--psm",
174	                    psm,
175	                    "-l",
176	                    "eng",
177	                    "tsv",
178	                    stdin=image,
179	                )
180	
181	                if tsv:
182	                    found_lines += _lines(_words(tsv.decode("utf-8", "replace")))
183	
184	            for line in found_lines:
185	                key = re.sub(r"\W+", "", line.lower())
186	
187	                if len(key) < 3:
188	                    continue
189	
190	                entry = seen.setdefault(key, {"text": line, "times": [], "frames": 0})
191	                if time_s not in entry["times"]:
192	                    entry["times"].append(time_s)
193	                    entry["frames"] += 1
194	
195	        lines = sorted(seen.values(), key=lambda e: (-e["frames"], e["times"][0]))
196	        out.artifact(
197	            "text",
198	            "table",
199	            "Recognised text",
200	            data={
201	                "columns": ["first seen (s)", "frames", "text"],
202	                "rows": [[e["times"][0], e["frames"], e["text"]] for e in lines[:200]],
203	            },
204	        )
205	        hits = []
206	        joined = "\n".join(e["text"] for e in lines)
207	
208	        for key, pattern, label, tag in _PATTERNS:
209	            for match in pattern.finditer(
210	                joined if key not in ("postcode", "plate") else joined.upper()
211	            ):
212	                value = match.group(0).strip()
213	                entry = next(
214	                    (
215	                        e
216	                        for e in lines
217	                        if value.lower().replace(" ", "")
218	                        in e["text"].lower().replace(" ", "")
219	                    ),
220	                    None,
221	                )
222	                hits.append(
223	                    {
224	                        "kind": key,
225	                        "value": value,
226	                        "label": label,
227	                        "tag": tag,
228	                        "time_s": entry["times"][0] if entry else None,
229	                    }
230	                )
231	
232	        unique = {(h["kind"], h["value"]): h for h in hits}
233	
234	        for hit in list(unique.values())[:12]:
235	            out.finding(
236	                "critical" if hit["kind"] in ("postcode", "plate") else "warning",
237	                f"{hit['label'][0].upper() + hit['label'][1:]} in frame: {hit['value']}",
238	                f"OCR reads a {hit['label']} in the picture. "
239	                + {
240	                    "location": "A postcode places the scene to a street.",
241	                    "vehicle": "A plate identifies a vehicle at the scene.",
242	                    "contact": "Contact details tie the scene to a business or person.",
243	                    "time": "Visible dates and clocks can confirm or contradict the claimed time.",
244	                }[hit["tag"]],
245	                time_s=hit["time_s"],
246	                tags=["text", hit["tag"]],
247	                data=hit,
248	            )
249	
250	        persistent = [e for e in lines if e["frames"] >= 2 or len(e["text"]) >= 8][:8]
251	
252	        if persistent:
253	            out.finding(
254	                "notice",
255	                f"{len(lines)} text fragments readable in frame",
256	                "Most legible: "
257	                + "; ".join(f'"{e["text"]}"' for e in persistent[:5])
258	                + ".",
259	                time_s=persistent[0]["times"][0],
260	                tags=["text"],
261	                data={"lines": [e["text"] for e in persistent]},
262	            )
263	        else:
264	            out.finding(
265	                "info",
266	                "No legible text in frame",
267	                "OCR found no readable text in the sampled frames"
268	                + (f" beyond {len(lines)} short fragments." if lines else "."),
269	                tags=["text"],
270	            )
271	
272	        ctx.publish(
273	            self.name,
274	            {"lines": [e["text"] for e in lines[:80]], "hits": list(unique.values())},
275	        )
276	        out.progress(1.0)

1	"""Thin OpenAI wrapper: key from the environment only, per-case caching, model fallback."""
2	
3	import hashlib
4	import json
5	import os
6	from typing import Any
7	
8	_VISION_MODELS = [
9	    m
10	    for m in [
11	        os.environ.get("EARWITNESS_OPENAI_MODEL"),
12	        "gpt-5.5",
13	        "gpt-5.4",
14	        "gpt-5",
15	        "gpt-4.1",
16	    ]
17	    if m
18	]
19	_working_model: str | None = None
20	
21	
22	def enabled() -> bool:
23	    return bool(os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY"))
24	
25	
26	def _client():
27	    from openai import AsyncOpenAI
28	
29	    return AsyncOpenAI()
30	
31	
32	def _cache(workdir: str, key: str) -> str:
33	    directory = os.path.join(workdir, "openai-cache")
34	    os.makedirs(directory, exist_ok=True)
35	
36	    return os.path.join(
37	        directory, hashlib.sha1(key.encode()).hexdigest()[:20] + ".json"
38	    )
39	
40	
41	async def structured(
42	    workdir: str,
43	    *,
44	    instructions: str,
45	    content: list[dict[str, Any]],
46	    schema: dict[str, Any],
47	    name: str,
48	    effort: str | None = None,
49	) -> dict[str, Any]:
50	    """JSON-schema-constrained response from the first model that works."""
51	    global _working_model
52	    from openai import APIStatusError
53	    from openai import NotFoundError
54	
55	    key = json.dumps(
56	        [instructions, content, schema, effort], sort_keys=True, default=str
57	    )
58	    path = _cache(workdir, key)
59	
60	    if os.path.isfile(path):
61	        with open(path) as handle:
62	            return json.load(handle)
63	
64	    client = _client()
65	    models = [_working_model] if _working_model else _VISION_MODELS
66	    last_error: Exception | None = None
67	
68	    for model in models:
69	        try:
70	            extra = {"reasoning": {"effort": effort}} if effort else {}
71	            response = await client.responses.create(
72	                **extra,
73	                model=model,
74	                instructions=instructions,
75	                input=[{"role": "user", "content": content}],
76	                text={
77	                    "format": {
78	                        "type": "json_schema",
79	                        "name": name,
80	                        "schema": schema,
81	                        "strict": True,
82	                    }
83	                },
84	            )
85	        except (NotFoundError, APIStatusError) as error:
86	            # Unknown model or no access: try the next one. Auth/quota errors repeat for all.
87	            last_error = error
88	            status = getattr(error, "status_code", None)
89	
90	            if status in (401, 429):
91	                raise
92	
93	            continue
94	
95	        _working_model = model
96	        result = json.loads(response.output_text)
97	        result["_model"] = model
98	
99	        with open(path, "w") as handle:
100	            json.dump(result, handle)
101	
102	        return result
103	
104	    raise RuntimeError(f"no OpenAI model available: {last_error}")
105	
106	
107	async def transcribe(
108	    workdir: str, audio_path: str, model: str = "whisper-1"
109	) -> dict[str, Any]:
110	    """Speech to text. whisper-1 gives timed segments and a language guess;
111	    newer models (gpt-4o-transcribe) give text only."""
112	    with open(audio_path, "rb") as handle:
113	        digest = hashlib.sha1(handle.read()).hexdigest()
114	
115	    path = _cache(workdir, f"transcribe:{model}:" + digest)
116	
117	    if os.path.isfile(path):
118	        with open(path) as handle:
119	            return json.load(handle)
120	
121	    client = _client()
122	
123	    with open(audio_path, "rb") as handle:
124	        if model == "whisper-1":
125	            response = await client.audio.transcriptions.create(
126	                model=model,
127	                file=handle,
128	                response_format="verbose_json",
129	                timestamp_granularities=["segment"],
130	            )
131	        else:
132	            response = await client.audio.transcriptions.create(
133	                model=model, file=handle
134	            )
135	
136	    result = (
137	        response.model_dump() if hasattr(response, "model_dump") else dict(response)
138	    )
139	
140	    with open(path, "w") as handle:
141	        json.dump(result, handle, default=str)
142	
143	    return result

1	"""'Enhance': multi-frame super-resolution of a region of interest.
2	
3	Neighbouring frames see the same detail shifted by sub-pixel amounts and with
4	independent noise. Upsampling each crop, aligning them to the centre frame and
5	averaging recovers detail no single frame shows (plates, signs, faces at
6	distance), then a light unsharp mask and local contrast make it legible.
7	"""
8	
9	import asyncio
10	import os
11	import time
12	from typing import Any
13	
14	import cv2
15	import numpy as np
16	
17	
18	def _align_and_stack(
19	    crops: list[np.ndarray], scale: int
20	) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, int]:
21	    up = [
22	        cv2.resize(c, None, fx=scale, fy=scale, interpolation=cv2.INTER_CUBIC).astype(
23	            np.float32
24	        )
25	        for c in crops
26	    ]
27	    centre = len(up) // 2
28	    reference = cv2.cvtColor(up[centre], cv2.COLOR_RGB2GRAY)
29	    aligned = [up[centre]]
30	    criteria = (cv2.TERM_CRITERIA_EPS | cv2.TERM_CRITERIA_COUNT, 60, 1e-4)
31	
32	    for index, image in enumerate(up):
33	        if index == centre:
34	            continue
35	
36	        gray = cv2.cvtColor(image, cv2.COLOR_RGB2GRAY)
37	        warp = np.eye(2, 3, dtype=np.float32)
38	
39	        try:
40	            score, warp = cv2.findTransformECC(
41	                reference, gray, warp, cv2.MOTION_EUCLIDEAN, criteria, None, 5
42	            )
43	        except cv2.error:
44	            continue
45	
46	        if score < 0.85:
47	            continue
48	
49	        aligned.append(
50	            cv2.warpAffine(
51	                image,
52	                warp,
53	                (image.shape[1], image.shape[0]),
54	                flags=cv2.INTER_CUBIC + cv2.WARP_INVERSE_MAP,
55	                borderMode=cv2.BORDER_REFLECT,
56	            )
57	        )
58	
59	    # Robust merge (as burst photography does): a neighbour's pixel only counts
60	    # where it agrees with the reference, so moving parts never ghost.
61	    base = up[centre]
62	    smooth_base = cv2.GaussianBlur(base, (0, 0), scale)
63	    total = base.copy()
64	    weight = np.ones(base.shape[:2] + (1,), dtype=np.float32)
65	
66	    for image in aligned[1:]:
67	        difference = np.abs(cv2.GaussianBlur(image, (0, 0), scale) - smooth_base).mean(
68	            axis=2, keepdims=True
69	        )
70	        w = np.exp(-((difference / 10.0) ** 2))
71	        total += w * image
72	        weight += w
73	
74	    merged = total / weight
75	    blurred = cv2.GaussianBlur(merged, (0, 0), 1.2 * scale / 2)
76	    sharp = cv2.addWeighted(merged, 1.8, blurred, -0.8, 0)
77	    sharp = np.clip(sharp, 0, 255).astype(np.uint8)
78	    lab = cv2.cvtColor(sharp, cv2.COLOR_RGB2LAB)
79	    clahe = cv2.createCLAHE(clipLimit=2.0, tileGridSize=(4, 4))
80	    lab[..., 0] = clahe.apply(lab[..., 0])
81	    enhanced = cv2.cvtColor(lab, cv2.COLOR_LAB2RGB)
82	    single = np.clip(up[centre], 0, 255).astype(np.uint8)
83	
84	    return single, enhanced, len(aligned)
85	
86	
87	async def enhance(
88	    case: Any, time_s: float, box: tuple[float, float, float, float], frames: int
89	) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
90	    ctx = case.ctx
91	
92	    if ctx is None:
93	        from earwitness.modules.base import CaseContext
94	
95	        ctx = CaseContext(case.id, case.evidence_path, case.workdir, case.options)
96	        case.ctx = ctx
97	
98	    info = await ctx.video_info()
99	
100	    if info is None:
101	        return None
102	
103	    frames = int(min(max(frames, 3), 25))
104	    start = max(0.0, time_s - (frames // 2) / info.fps)
105	    clip = await ctx.clip_frames(start, frames)
106	
107	    if clip is None or len(clip) == 0:
108	        return None
109	
110	    height, width = clip.shape[1:3]
111	    x, y, w, h = box
112	    x0, y0 = int(max(0, x) * width), int(max(0, y) * height)
113	    x1, y1 = int(min(1, x + w) * width), int(min(1, y + h) * height)
114	
115	    if x1 - x0 < 8 or y1 - y0 < 8:
116	        return None
117	
118	    crops = [frame[y0:y1, x0:x1] for frame in clip]
119	    scale = int(np.clip(480 / max(x1 - x0, y1 - y0), 2, 6))
120	    single, enhanced, used = await asyncio.to_thread(_align_and_stack, crops, scale)
121	    directory = os.path.join(case.workdir, "enhance")
122	    os.makedirs(directory, exist_ok=True)
123	    stamp = f"{int(time.time() * 1000)}"
124	    paths = {}
125	
126	    for name, image in (("single", single), ("enhanced", enhanced)):
127	        path = os.path.join(directory, f"{stamp}-{name}.png")
128	        cv2.imwrite(path, cv2.cvtColor(image, cv2.COLOR_RGB2BGR))
129	        paths[name] = f"/api/cases/{case.id}/files/enhance/{os.path.basename(path)}"
130	
131	    return {
132	        "single_url": paths["single"],
133	        "enhanced_url": paths["enhanced"],
134	        "frames_used": used,
135	        "scale": scale,
136	        "source_px": [x1 - x0, y1 - y0],
137	        "time_s": time_s,
138	    }

69	export function reduce(state: CaseState, action: Action): CaseState {
70	  if (action.type === 'reset') return emptyState()
71	
72	  let s: CaseState = { ...state, seen: new Set(state.seen) }
73	  let modules = { ...s.modules }
74	  let findings = s.findings
75	  let artifacts = s.artifacts
76	  let artifactOrder = s.artifactOrder
77	  let logs = s.logs
78	  const now = Date.now()
79	
80	  for (const ev of action.events) {
81	    // Server-side rerun: drop everything; new events follow from seq 0.
82	    if (ev.type === 'reset') {
83	      s = { ...emptyState(), seen: new Set() }
84	      modules = {}
85	      findings = []
86	      artifacts = {}
87	      artifactOrder = []
88	      logs = []
89	      continue
90	    }
91	    // A rerun restarts seq at 0 with a fresh `case` event: start over.
92	    if (ev.type === 'case' && ev.seq === 0 && s.seen.size > 0) {
93	      s = { ...emptyState(), seen: new Set() }
94	      modules = {}
95	      findings = []
96	      artifacts = {}
97	      artifactOrder = []
98	      logs = []
99	    }
100	    if (typeof ev.seq === 'number') {
101	      if (s.seen.has(ev.seq)) continue
102	      s.seen.add(ev.seq)
103	    }
104	    if (ev.ts) s.lastTs = Math.max(s.lastTs, ev.ts)
105	
106	    switch (ev.type) {
107	      case 'case': {
108	        s.info = ev.case
109	        if (ev.case.media_url) {
110	          s.mediaUrl = ev.case.media_url
111	          s.mediaReady = true
112	        }
113	        const order: string[] = []
114	        for (const m of ev.case.modules ?? []) {
115	          order.push(m.name)
116	          modules[m.name] = { ...(modules[m.name] ?? blankModule(m.name)), title: m.title, description: m.description }
117	        }
118	        s.moduleOrder = order
119	        break
120	      }
121	      case 'media':
122	        s.mediaUrl = ev.media_url
123	        s.mediaReady = true
124	        break
125	      case 'module': {
126	        const prev = modules[ev.module] ?? blankModule(ev.module)
127	        if (!s.moduleOrder.includes(ev.module)) s.moduleOrder = [...s.moduleOrder, ev.module]
128	        const next: ModuleState = {
129	          ...prev,
130	          status: ev.status,
131	          progress: typeof ev.progress === 'number' ? ev.progress : prev.progress,
132	          message: ev.message ?? (ev.status === prev.status ? prev.message : ''),
133	          elapsed_s: ev.elapsed_s ?? prev.elapsed_s,
134	          trace: ev.trace ?? prev.trace,
135	          started_ts: ev.status === 'running' && prev.started_ts == null ? ev.ts : prev.started_ts,
136	        }
137	        modules[ev.module] = next
138	        if (ev.status !== prev.status || ev.status === 'error') {
139	          logs = [
140	            ...logs,
141	            {
142	              seq: ev.seq,
143	              ts: ev.ts,
144	              module: ev.module,
145	              message: `${ev.status.toUpperCase()}${ev.message ? ` ${ev.message}` : ''}${ev.elapsed_s != null ? ` (${ev.elapsed_s.toFixed(2)}s)` : ''}`,
146	              level: ev.status === 'error' ? 'error' : 'module',
147	            },
148	          ]
149	        } else if (ev.message) {
150	          logs = [...logs, { seq: ev.seq, ts: ev.ts, module: ev.module, message: ev.message, level: 'module' }]
151	        }
152	        break
153	      }
154	      case 'finding': {
155	        const f = ev.finding
156	        const idx = findings.findIndex((x) => x.id === f.id)
157	        if (idx >= 0) {
158	          findings = findings.slice()
159	          findings[idx] = { ...f, at: findings[idx].at }
160	        } else findings = [...findings, { ...f, at: now }]
161	        logs = [...logs, { seq: ev.seq, ts: ev.ts, module: f.module, message: `[${f.severity.toUpperCase()}] ${f.title}`, level: 'log' }]
162	        break
163	      }
164	      case 'artifact': {
165	        const a = ev.artifact
166	        const prev = artifacts[a.id]
167	        artifacts = { ...artifacts, [a.id]: { ...a, at: prev?.at ?? now } }
168	        if (!prev) artifactOrder = [...artifactOrder, a.id]
169	        break
170	      }
171	      case 'log':
172	        logs = [...logs, { seq: ev.seq, ts: ev.ts, module: ev.module ?? 'core', message: ev.message, level: 'log' }]
173	        break
174	      case 'done':
175	        s.done = true
176	        logs = [...logs, { seq: ev.seq, ts: ev.ts, module: 'core', message: 'ALL MODULES COMPLETE', level: 'module' }]
177	        break
178	      case 'error':
179	        s.error = ev.message
180	        break
181	    }
182	  }
183	
184	  if (logs.length > MAX_LOG) logs = logs.slice(-MAX_LOG)
185	  return { ...s, modules, findings, artifacts, artifactOrder, logs }
186	}

2	
3	The way an OSINT analyst works, automated:
4	
5	1. Gather clues: several varied frames, zoomed edge and corner crops from
6	   geo-sleuth (https://github.com/Oldcircle/geo-sleuth), OCR text, spoken
7	   language and the transcript, what an AI listener heard (accents, sirens,
8	   announcements), and which power grid the lights run on.
9	2. Propose: a reasoning model lists candidate places, each with coordinates
10	   and, where there is one, a named landmark.
11	3. Verify: for every candidate, fetch the landmark's reference photo from
12	   Wikipedia and the satellite image of its coordinates (Esri World Imagery),
13	   and have a second pass compare them with the frames. A candidate becomes
14	   the answer only if it survives that comparison.
15	
16	The model never sees the file's GPS or metadata. When the file does carry
17	GPS, the error in km is reported, which keeps the whole thing honest.
18

179	def _haversine_km(a: tuple[float, float], b: tuple[float, float]) -> float:
180	    lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2 = map(math.radians, (*a, *b))
181	    h = (
182	        math.sin((lat2 - lat1) / 2) ** 2
183	        + math.cos(lat1) * math.cos(lat2) * math.sin((lon2 - lon1) / 2) ** 2
184	    )
185	
186	    return 2 * 6371.0 * math.asin(math.sqrt(h))

190	    image = cv2.imread(path)
191	
192	    if image is None:

194

294	    """The sharpest frame from each of _FRAMES equal stretches of the clip."""
295	    chosen = []

299	        best = None

312	                best = (sharp, float(t), frame)
313	
314	        if best:

316	
317	    return chosen

257	/** The tab an artifact lives in. Maps go to Place, captions to Text. */
258	export function artifactTab(a: Artifact): TabKey {
259	  if (a.kind === 'map') return 'place'
260	  if (a.kind === 'captions') return 'text'
261	  if (a.module === 'geo') return 'place'
262	  if (a.id === 'provenance:probe' || a.module === 'provenance') return 'file'
263	  return MODULE_TAB[a.module] ?? 'picture'
264	}

266	export function findingInTab(f: Finding, tab: TabDef): boolean {
267	  if (tab.modules.includes(f.module)) return true
268	  if (!tab.modules.length) return false
269	  return (f.tags ?? []).some((t) => tab.tags.includes(t))
270	}

333	export function explainArtifact(a: Artifact): string {
334	  if (EXPLAIN[a.id]) return EXPLAIN[a.id]
335	  const stem = `${a.module}:${a.name.replace(/[_\d.]+$/, '').replace(/_\d.*$/, '')}`
336	  if (EXPLAIN[stem]) return EXPLAIN[stem]
337	  const prefix = Object.keys(EXPLAIN).find((k) => a.id.startsWith(k))
338	  if (prefix) return EXPLAIN[prefix]
339	  return KIND_EXPLAIN[a.kind] ?? ''
340	}

443	/** Unit for a data key, from its suffix. */
444	export function unitFor(key: string): string {
445	  if (key === 'bpm') return 'bpm'
446	  if (/_hz$|^hz$/.test(key)) return 'Hz'
447	  if (/_db$/.test(key)) return 'dB'
448	  if (/_ms$/.test(key)) return 'ms'
449	  if (/_s$/.test(key)) return 's'
450	  if (/_km$/.test(key)) return 'km'
451	  if (/_m$/.test(key)) return 'm'
452	  if (/_h$/.test(key)) return 'h'
453	  if (key === 'elevation' || key === 'azimuth' || key === 'sun_elevation') return '°'
454	  return ''
455	}

1	// Pull the headline facts out of the event stream, defensively (fields vary by case and backend version).
2	import type { Answer, Artifact, Finding } from './types'
3	import type { CaseState } from './state'
4	import { isTerminal } from './state'
5	import { verdictOf, type Verdict } from './plain'
6	
7	export interface Facts {
8	  verdict: Verdict
9	  brief: Artifact | null
10	  answers: Answer[]
11	  summary: string | null
12	  running: boolean
13	  checksDone: number
14	  checksTotal: number
15	  counts: Record<string, number>
16	  device: string | null
17	  software: string | null
18	  resaved: string | null
19	  recorded: string | null
20	  gps: { lat: number; lon: number; accuracy_m?: number; place?: string; alt_m?: number } | null
21	  grid: number | null
22	  pulse: number | null
23	  language: string | null
24	  aiUsed: boolean
25	  hasAudio: boolean
26	  currentModule: string | null
27	}
28	
29	const firstData = (findings: Finding[], pred: (f: Finding) => boolean) => findings.find(pred)?.data ?? null
30	
31	export function deriveFacts(state: CaseState, openai: boolean | null): Facts {
32	  const arts = state.artifactOrder.map((id) => state.artifacts[id])
33	  const brief = state.artifacts['brief:brief'] ?? arts.find((a) => a.kind === 'brief') ?? null
34	  const fs = state.findings
35	  const order = state.moduleOrder
36	  const done = order.filter((n) => state.modules[n] && isTerminal(state.modules[n].status)).length
37	  const running = !!state.info && !state.done && done < order.length
38	  const counts: Record<string, number> = { critical: 0, warning: 0, notice: 0, info: 0 }
39	  for (const f of fs) counts[f.severity] = (counts[f.severity] ?? 0) + 1
40	
41	  const dev = firstData(fs, (f) => f.module === 'provenance' && !!f.data?.model)
42	  const device = dev ? [dev.make, dev.model].filter(Boolean).join(' ') : null
43	  const resavedF = fs.find((f) => f.tags?.includes('software') || f.tags?.includes('editor'))
44	  const resaved = resavedF ? resavedF.title.replace(/^Processed by\s*/i, '').replace(/\s*\(.*\)$/, '') : null
45	
46	  const clock = firstData(fs, (f) => !!f.data?.creation_time_utc)
47	  const gpsD = firstData(fs, (f) => f.tags?.includes('gps') && isFinite(f.data?.lat))
48	  const gridD = firstData(fs, (f) => typeof f.data?.grid_hz === 'number')
49	  const nominal = fs.find((f) => /\b(50|60) Hz grid\b/.test(f.title))
50	  const pulseD = firstData(fs, (f) => f.module === 'pulse' && typeof f.data?.bpm === 'number')
51	  const lang = firstData(fs, (f) => typeof f.data?.language === 'string')
52	
53	  const answers: Answer[] = Array.isArray(brief?.data?.answers) ? brief!.data.answers : []
54	  const current = order.find((n) => state.modules[n]?.status === 'running') ?? null
55	  const aiUsed = fs.some((f) => f.kind === 'inferred') || answers.some((a) => a.ai)
56	
57	  return {
58	    verdict: state.error ? 'unknown' : running && !brief ? 'running' : brief ? verdictOf(brief.data?.verdict) : state.done ? 'unknown' : 'running',
59	    brief,
60	    answers,
61	    summary: brief?.data?.summary_plain ?? brief?.data?.headline ?? null,
62	    running,
63	    checksDone: done,
64	    checksTotal: order.length,
65	    counts,
66	    device,
67	    software: dev?.software ?? null,
68	    resaved,
69	    recorded: clock?.creation_time_utc ?? null,
70	    gps: gpsD ? { lat: gpsD.lat, lon: gpsD.lon, accuracy_m: gpsD.accuracy_m, place: gpsD.place, alt_m: gpsD.alt_m } : null,
71	    grid: gridD?.grid_hz ?? (nominal ? Number(nominal.title.match(/\b(50|60) Hz grid/)![1]) : null),
72	    pulse: pulseD ? Math.round(pulseD.bpm) : null,
73	    language: lang?.language ?? null,
74	    aiUsed: aiUsed || !!openai,
75	    hasAudio: !!state.info?.has_audio,
76	    currentModule: current,
77	  }
78	}

80	/** Severity rank then time, for the findings "leaderboard". */
81	export function rankFindings(fs: Finding[]): Finding[] {
82	  const sev: Record<string, number> = { critical: 0, warning: 1, notice: 2, info: 3 }
83	  return [...fs].sort(
84	    (a, b) => (sev[a.severity] ?? 9) - (sev[b.severity] ?? 9) || (a.time_s ?? 1e9) - (b.time_s ?? 1e9) || a.id.localeCompare(b.id),
85	  )
86	}

1	"""Tiger Data (TimescaleDB) storage: the grid-frequency record and the case index.
2	
3	The database is required. Its URL comes from TIMESCALE_SERVICE_URL (read from
4	the repo's .env); tables live in the schema named by EARWITNESS_DB_SCHEMA
5	(default ``earwitness``), which lets tests run in a throwaway schema.
6	
7	Long-lived processes (the server) open a connection pool for their event loop
8	with ``open_pool``; anything else (CLI, demo, tests) gets a one-shot connection.
9	"""
10	
11	import asyncio
12	import hashlib
13	import json
14	import os
15	import re
16	from collections.abc import AsyncIterator
17	from collections.abc import Iterable
18	from contextlib import asynccontextmanager
19	from datetime import datetime
20	from datetime import timezone
21	from typing import Any
22	
23	import psycopg
24	from dotenv import load_dotenv
25	from psycopg import sql
26	from psycopg.rows import dict_row
27	from psycopg.types.json import Jsonb
28	from psycopg_pool import AsyncConnectionPool
29	
30	_ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))
31	_SCHEMA_SQL = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "schema.sql")
32	_IDENT = re.compile(r"^[a-z_][a-z0-9_]{0,62}$")
33	
34	load_dotenv(os.path.join(_ROOT, ".env"))
35	
36	_pools: dict[asyncio.AbstractEventLoop, AsyncConnectionPool] = {}
37	
38	
39	class DatabaseNotConfigured(RuntimeError):
40	    def __init__(self) -> None:
41	        super().__init__(
42	            "TIMESCALE_SERVICE_URL is not set. Earwitness needs its Tiger Data "
43	            "database: put the service URL in .env (see .env.example)."
44	        )
45	
46	
47	def url() -> str:
48	    value = os.environ.get("TIMESCALE_SERVICE_URL", "").strip()
49	
50	    if not value:
51	        raise DatabaseNotConfigured()
52	
53	    return value
54	
55	
56	def schema() -> str:
57	    name = os.environ.get("EARWITNESS_DB_SCHEMA", "earwitness").strip()
58	
59	    if not _IDENT.match(name):
60	        raise ValueError(f"EARWITNESS_DB_SCHEMA {name!r} is not a plain identifier")
61	
62	    return name
63	
64	
65	async def _configure(conn: psycopg.AsyncConnection) -> None:
66	    await conn.execute(
67	        sql.SQL("SET search_path TO {}, public").format(sql.Identifier(schema()))
68	    )
69	    await conn.commit()
70	
71	
72	async def open_pool() -> AsyncConnectionPool:
73	    """Open (once) a pool bound to the running event loop."""
74	    loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
75	
76	    if loop not in _pools:
77	        pool = AsyncConnectionPool(
78	            url(), min_size=1, max_size=5, configure=_configure, open=False
79	        )
80	        await pool.open(wait=True, timeout=30)
81	        _pools[loop] = pool
82	
83	    return _pools[loop]
84	
85	
86	async def close_pool() -> None:
87	    pool = _pools.pop(asyncio.get_running_loop(), None)
88	
89	    if pool is not None:
90	        await pool.close()
91	
92	
93	@asynccontextmanager
94	async def connection() -> AsyncIterator[psycopg.AsyncConnection]:
95	    pool = _pools.get(asyncio.get_running_loop())
96	
97	    if pool is not None:
98	        async with pool.connection() as conn:
99	            yield conn
100	
101	        return
102	
103	    async with await psycopg.AsyncConnection.connect(url()) as conn:
104	        await _configure(conn)
105	        yield conn
106	
107	
108	def _statements(text: str) -> list[str]:
109	    lines = [line for line in text.splitlines() if not line.lstrip().startswith("--")]
110	
111	    return [s.strip() for s in "\n".join(lines).split(";") if s.strip()]
112	
113	
114	async def migrate() -> bool:
115	    """Apply schema.sql if it changed since the last run; True when applied."""
116	    with open(_SCHEMA_SQL) as handle:
117	        text = handle.read()
118	
119	    digest = hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest()
120	    name = sql.Identifier(schema())
121	
122	    # Continuous aggregates cannot be created inside a transaction.
123	    async with await psycopg.AsyncConnection.connect(url(), autocommit=True) as conn:
124	        await conn.execute(sql.SQL("CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS {}").format(name))
125	        await conn.execute(sql.SQL("SET search_path TO {}, public").format(name))
126	        await conn.execute(
127	            "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS schema_version ("
128	            " digest TEXT PRIMARY KEY, applied_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now())"
129	        )
130	        seen = await (
131	            await conn.execute(
132	                "SELECT 1 FROM schema_version WHERE digest = %s", [digest]
133	            )
134	        ).fetchone()
135	
136	        if seen:
137	            return False
138	
139	        for statement in _statements(text):
140	            await conn.execute(statement)

1	"""Weather witness: what the sky was really doing there and then.
2	
3	If the place (GPS, or a verified geolocation) and the time (metadata that is
4	not a copy stamp, or an ENF date) are known, fetch the recorded weather for
5	that hour from Open-Meteo's historical archive and compare it with what the
6	AI analyst sees in the frames. Rain in the record and a dry, sunny video (or
7	the reverse) means the claimed time or place is wrong.
8	"""
9	
10	import re
11	from datetime import datetime
12	from datetime import timedelta
13	from datetime import timezone
14	from typing import Any
15	
16	import httpx
17	
18	from earwitness.modules.base import CaseContext
19	from earwitness.modules.base import Reporter
20	from earwitness.modules.base import Skip
21	
22	_CODES = {
23	    0: "clear sky", 1: "mainly clear", 2: "partly cloudy", 3: "overcast", 45: "fog", 48: "freezing fog",
24	    51: "light drizzle", 53: "drizzle", 55: "heavy drizzle", 56: "freezing drizzle", 57: "freezing drizzle",
25	    61: "light rain", 63: "rain", 65: "heavy rain", 66: "freezing rain", 67: "freezing rain",
26	    71: "light snow", 73: "snow", 75: "heavy snow", 77: "snow grains", 80: "rain showers",
27	    81: "rain showers", 82: "violent rain showers", 85: "snow showers", 86: "heavy snow showers",
28	    95: "thunderstorm", 96: "thunderstorm with hail", 99: "thunderstorm with hail",
29	}  # fmt: skip
30	_WET_WORDS = ("rain", "wet", "drizzle", "puddle", "umbrella", "snow", "shower", "storm")
31	_DRY_WORDS = ("dry", "sunny", "clear sky", "clear, ", "bright sun")
32	
33	
34	_NEGATED = re.compile(
35	    r"\b(no|not|without|isn't|aren't|nor|never|free of)\b(\s+\w+){0,3}?\s+"
36	    r"(rain\w*|wet|drizzle|puddles?|umbrellas?|snow\w*|showers?|storms?)\b"
37	)
38	
39	
40	def _seen_conditions(seen: str) -> tuple[bool, bool]:
41	    """(looks wet, looks dry) from the analyst's words, ignoring negations
42	    such as "no visible rain" or "not raining"."""
43	    text = _NEGATED.sub(" ", seen.lower())
44	    wet = any(w in text for w in _WET_WORDS)
45	    dry = (any(w in text for w in _DRY_WORDS) or "dry" in text) and not wet
46	
47	    return wet, dry
48	
49	
50	async def _hourly(lat: float, lon: float, when: datetime) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
51	    day = when.astimezone(timezone.utc).date()
52	    params = {
53	        "latitude": lat, "longitude": lon, "start_date": day.isoformat(), "end_date": day.isoformat(),
54	        "hourly": "temperature_2m,precipitation,cloud_cover,weather_code,wind_speed_10m,is_day",
55	        "timezone": "UTC",
56	    }  # fmt: skip
57	    recent = datetime.now(timezone.utc).date() - day < timedelta(days=6)
58	    url = (
59	        "https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast"
60	        if recent
61	        else "https://archive-api.open-meteo.com/v1/archive"
62	    )
63	
64	    try:
65	        async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=15) as client:
66	            response = await client.get(url, params=params)
67	            response.raise_for_status()
68	            data = response.json()["hourly"]
69	    except httpx.HTTPError, KeyError, ValueError:
70	        return None
71	
72	    hour = when.astimezone(timezone.utc).hour
73	
74	    if hour >= len(data.get("time", [])):
75	        return None
76	
77	    return {key: values[hour] for key, values in data.items()} | {"source": url}
78	
79	
80	class Weather:
81	    name = "weather"
82	    title = "WEATHER WITNESS"
83	    description = "Real recorded weather at the claimed place and time, checked against what the video shows."
84	    depends = ["provenance", "enf", "geo", "vision"]
85	
86	    async def run(self, ctx: CaseContext, out: Reporter) -> None:
87	        provenance = await ctx.wait_for("provenance") or {}
88	        enf = await ctx.wait_for("enf") or {}
89	        geo = await ctx.wait_for("geo") or {}
90	        place, place_source = None, None
91	
92	        if provenance.get("location"):
93	            place, place_source = provenance["location"], "the file's GPS"
94	        elif geo.get("verified"):
95	            place, place_source = (
96	                {"lat": geo["latitude"], "lon": geo["longitude"]},
97	                "the verified geolocation",
98	            )
99	
100	        when, when_source = None, None
101	
102	        if enf.get("confident") and enf.get("dated_start"):
103	            when, when_source = enf["dated_start"], "the power-grid dating"
104	        elif provenance.get("start_guess"):
105	            when, when_source = provenance["start_guess"], "the file's own timestamp"
106	
107	        if isinstance(when, str):
108	            when = datetime.fromisoformat(when)
109	
110	        if place is None or when is None:
111	            raise Skip("needs both a place and a trustworthy time")
112	
113	        out.progress(0.3, "fetching the weather record")
114	        record = await _hourly(float(place["lat"]), float(place["lon"]), when)
115	
116	        if record is None:
117	            raise Skip("no weather record for that place and hour")
118	
119	        sky = _CODES.get(int(record.get("weather_code") or 0), "unknown")
120	        summary = (
121	            f"{record['temperature_2m']:.0f}°C, {sky}, {record['precipitation']:.1f} mm of rain that hour, "
122	            f"{record['cloud_cover']:.0f}% cloud, wind {record['wind_speed_10m']:.0f} km/h, "
123	            f"{'daylight' if record.get('is_day') else 'dark'}"
124	        )
125	        out.artifact(
126	            "record",
127	            "table",
128	            "Recorded weather for that place and hour",
129	            data={
130	                "columns": ["measure", "value"],
131	                "rows": [[k, v] for k, v in record.items()],
132	            },
133	        )
134	        vision = await ctx.wait_for("vision") or {}
135	        seen = f"{vision.get('weather', '')} {vision.get('scene', '')}".lower()
136	        wet_record = float(record.get("precipitation") or 0) >= 0.5 or sky.endswith(
137	            ("rain", "drizzle", "showers")
138	        )
139	        dry_record = (
140	            float(record.get("precipitation") or 0) == 0
141	            and int(record.get("weather_code") or 0) <= 2
142	        )
143	        wet_seen, dry_seen = _seen_conditions(seen)
144	        contradiction = (wet_record and dry_seen) or (dry_record and wet_seen)
145	        detail = (
146	            f"At {when:%Y-%m-%d %H:00} UTC at that spot (place from {place_source}, time from "
147	            f"{when_source}) the weather record says: {summary}."
148	        )
149	
150	        if seen.strip():
151	            detail += f" The AI analyst sees: {vision.get('weather') or 'no weather described'}."
152	
153	        out.finding(
154	            "warning" if contradiction else "info",
155	            "Weather contradicts the claimed time or place"
156	            if contradiction
157	            else f"Weather there and then: {sky}, {record['temperature_2m']:.0f}°C",
158	            detail
159	            + (
160	                " These do not fit together: either the time, the place, or the footage is not what it claims."
161	                if contradiction
162	                else ""
163	            ),
164	            tags=["weather", "time", "location"]
165	            + (["inconsistency"] if contradiction else []),
166	            data=record
167	            | {"sky": sky, "place_source": place_source, "time_source": when_source},
168	        )
169	        ctx.publish(self.name, record | {"sky": sky, "contradiction": contradiction})
170	        out.progress(1.0)

---SCHEMA
-- Earwitness schema. Applied by earwitness.db.migrate() inside the schema named
-- by EARWITNESS_DB_SCHEMA (search_path is set first), so nothing here is
-- schema-qualified. Every statement must be idempotent.

-- GB grid frequency, one row per sample, from every source we have fetched.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS grid_frequency (
    time   TIMESTAMPTZ      NOT NULL,
    source TEXT             NOT NULL,
    hz     DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (source, time)
) WITH (
    tsdb.hypertable,
    tsdb.segmentby = 'source',
    tsdb.orderby = 'time DESC'
);

-- Windows already fetched from a source: tells "never fetched" apart from
-- "fetched and complete", so a covered window needs no HTTP at all.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS grid_coverage (
    source     TEXT        NOT NULL,
    start_ts   TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    end_ts     TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    fetched_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS grid_coverage_span ON grid_coverage (source, start_ts, end_ts);

-- Minute summary of the grid record, kept fresh by TimescaleDB.
CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW IF NOT EXISTS grid_frequency_1m
WITH (timescaledb.continuous) AS
SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', time) AS bucket,
       source,
       avg(hz) AS avg_hz,
       min(hz) AS min_hz,
       max(hz) AS max_hz,
       count(*) AS samples
FROM grid_frequency
GROUP BY bucket, source
WITH NO DATA;

-- Real-time: windows stored since the last refresh are included straight away.
ALTER MATERIALIZED VIEW grid_frequency_1m SET (timescaledb.materialized_only = false);

SELECT add_continuous_aggregate_policy(
    'grid_frequency_1m',
    start_offset => NULL,
    end_offset => INTERVAL '1 minute',
    schedule_interval => INTERVAL '10 minutes',
    if_not_exists => true
);

-- Index of every analysed clip. events.jsonl stays the replay source of truth.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cases (
    id            TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    filename      TEXT        NOT NULL,
    created       TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    status        TEXT        NOT NULL,
    sha256        TEXT,
    duration_s    DOUBLE PRECISION,
    verdict       TEXT,
    summary_plain TEXT,
    dated_start   TIMESTAMPTZ,
    options       JSONB       NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    updated_at    TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS cases_dated_start ON cases (dated_start);

-- Every finding of every case, on the time it was reported.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS findings (
    time       TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    case_id    TEXT        NOT NULL,
    finding_id TEXT        NOT NULL,
    module     TEXT        NOT NULL,
    severity   TEXT        NOT NULL,
    title      TEXT        NOT NULL,
    detail     TEXT,
    tags       TEXT[]      NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    data       JSONB       NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    PRIMARY KEY (case_id, finding_id, time)
) WITH (
    tsdb.hypertable,
    tsdb.segmentby = 'case_id',
    tsdb.orderby = 'time DESC'
);

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Deploy Earwitness to a fresh Ubuntu server over SSH (password auth).
#
#   bash scripts/deploy.sh [user@host]                      # with the deploy key
#   SSHPASS='server-password' bash scripts/deploy.sh         # first time, no key yet
#
# A password is only read from $SSHPASS (for SSH and sudo) and never written
# to disk. With the key, sudo must be passwordless on the server. Re-running the script updates the code
# and restarts the service.
set -euo pipefail

TARGET="${1:-linuxuser@78.141.206.107}"
ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)"
KEY="${DEPLOY_KEY:-$HOME/.ssh/REDACTED_deploy}"

# Prefer the deploy key (no password needed); fall back to SSHPASS.
if [[ -f "$KEY" ]] && ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=8 -i "$KEY" "$TARGET" true 2>/dev/null; then
  SSH_OPTS=(-o BatchMode=yes -i "$KEY")
  RUN=()
  SUDO_LINE=""
elif [[ -n "${SSHPASS:-}" ]]; then
  command -v sshpass >/dev/null || brew install hudochenkov/sshpass/sshpass
  SSH_OPTS=(-o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new -o PubkeyAuthentication=no -o PreferredAuthentications=password)
  RUN=(sshpass -e)
  SUDO_LINE="$SSHPASS"
else
  echo "No working deploy key ($KEY) and no SSHPASS set." >&2
  exit 1
fi

echo "==> Copying code to $TARGET:~/REDACTED"
"${RUN[@]}" rsync -az --delete \
  -e "ssh ${SSH_OPTS[*]}" \
  --exclude .venv --exclude web/node_modules --exclude web/dist --exclude web/dist-stable \
  --exclude cases --exclude __pycache__ --exclude .pytest_cache --exclude .ruff_cache \
  --exclude .git --exclude .DS_Store \
  "$ROOT/" "$TARGET:REDACTED/"

echo "==> Setting up the server (this takes a few minutes the first time)"
# bash -s reads its script from stdin line by line: the first line reads the
# next line (the sudo password) into a variable, then the setup script follows.
{ printf 'read -r SUDO_PASS\n%s\n' "$SUDO_LINE"; cat "$ROOT/scripts/remote_setup.sh"; } |
  "${RUN[@]}" ssh "${SSH_OPTS[@]}" "$TARGET" 'bash -s'

HOST="${TARGET#*@}"
echo "==> Done: http://$HOST/"
---SETUP
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Runs ON the server, streamed by scripts/deploy.sh, which first sends
# `read -r SUDO_PASS` and the password line, so SUDO_PASS is already set here.
set -euo pipefail
s() { printf '%s\n' "$SUDO_PASS" | sudo -S -p '' "$@"; }
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
cd ~/REDACTED

echo "--> system packages"
s apt-get update -qq
s apt-get install -y -qq git curl build-essential rsync ffmpeg tesseract-ocr tesseract-ocr-eng nginx docker.io >/dev/null

# ffmpeg must be >= 5.1 (-fps_mode). Ubuntu 22.04 ships 4.4: use a static build then.
if ! ffmpeg -hide_banner -h full 2>/dev/null | grep -q -- '-fps_mode'; then
  echo "--> installing static ffmpeg (system one is too old)"
  curl -fsSL https://johnvansickle.com/ffmpeg/releases/ffmpeg-release-amd64-static.tar.xz -o /tmp/ffmpeg.tar.xz
  tar -xf /tmp/ffmpeg.tar.xz -C /tmp
  s cp /tmp/ffmpeg-*-amd64-static/ffmpeg /tmp/ffmpeg-*-amd64-static/ffprobe /usr/local/bin/
fi

echo "--> node 22"
node_ok() { command -v npm >/dev/null && node -v 2>/dev/null | grep -qE '^v(2[2-9]|[3-9][0-9])'; }

if ! node_ok; then
  curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_22.x -o /tmp/nodesource.sh
  s bash /tmp/nodesource.sh
  s apt-get install -y -qq nodejs
  hash -r
fi

if ! command -v npm >/dev/null; then
  echo "NodeSource gave no npm; falling back to Ubuntu's npm"
  s apt-get install -y -qq npm
  hash -r
fi

echo "node $(node -v), npm $(npm -v)"

echo "--> uv"
command -v uv >/dev/null || curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh >/dev/null
hash -r
UV="$(command -v uv)"
echo "uv at $UV"

# .env must end with a newline before anything is appended.
touch .env
[[ -z "$(tail -c1 .env)" ]] || echo >> .env

echo "--> database"
if ! grep -q '^TIMESCALE_SERVICE_URL=' .env; then
  s systemctl enable --now docker >/dev/null
  if ! s docker ps -a --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -qx tsdb; then
    s docker run -d --name tsdb --restart unless-stopped -p 127.0.0.1:5432:5432 \
      -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=REDACTED timescale/timescaledb:latest-pg17 >/dev/null
  fi
  echo "TIMESCALE_SERVICE_URL=REDACTED" >> .env
fi

if s docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' 2>/dev/null | grep -qx tsdb; then
  for _ in $(seq 1 30); do s docker exec tsdb pg_isready -q && break; sleep 2; done
fi

echo "--> geo-sleuth"
mkdir -p ~/.cache/REDACTED/vendor
[[ -d ~/.cache/REDACTED/vendor/geo-sleuth ]] || \
  git clone -q --depth 1 https://github.com/Oldcircle/geo-sleuth ~/.cache/REDACTED/vendor/geo-sleuth
sed -i '/^EARWITNESS_GEOSLEUTH=/d' .env
echo "EARWITNESS_GEOSLEUTH=$HOME/.cache/REDACTED/vendor/geo-sleuth/skills/geo-sleuth" >> .env

echo "--> python packages"
uv sync -q

echo "--> web UI"
(cd web && npm install --no-audit --no-fund --loglevel=error && npm run build >/dev/null)

echo "--> migrate"
uv run REDACTED db migrate

echo "--> service"
cat > /tmp/REDACTED.service <<EOF
[Unit]
Description=Earwitness video forensics
After=network-online.target docker.service

[Service]
User=$USER
WorkingDirectory=$HOME/REDACTED
Environment=HOME=$HOME
Environment=PATH=$HOME/.local/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin
ExecStart=$UV run REDACTED serve --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8765
Restart=always
RestartSec=3

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF
s cp /tmp/REDACTED.service /etc/systemd/system/REDACTED.service
s systemctl daemon-reload
s systemctl enable REDACTED >/dev/null
s systemctl restart REDACTED

echo "--> nginx"
cat > /tmp/REDACTED.nginx <<'EOF'
server {
    listen 80 default_server;
    listen [::]:80 default_server;
    client_max_body_size 4G;
    proxy_read_timeout 3600s;
    proxy_send_timeout 3600s;

    location /ws/ {
        proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:8765;
        proxy_http_version 1.1;
        proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade;
        proxy_set_header Connection "upgrade";
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
    }

    location / {
        proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:8765;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
        proxy_request_buffering off;
    }
}
EOF
s cp /tmp/REDACTED.nginx /etc/nginx/sites-available/REDACTED
s ln -sf /etc/nginx/sites-available/REDACTED /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/REDACTED
s rm -f /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/default
s nginx -t -q
s systemctl reload nginx

if s ufw status 2>/dev/null | grep -q "Status: active"; then
  s ufw allow 80/tcp >/dev/null
fi

echo "--> health check"
for _ in $(seq 1 30); do
  if curl -fs http://127.0.0.1/api/health >/dev/null; then
    curl -s http://127.0.0.1/api/health | head -c 120; echo
    exit 0
  fi
  sleep 2
done

echo "Service did not come up; last logs:"
s journalctl -u REDACTED -n 40 --no-pager
exit 1

"""Who took this photo, when, where, with what, and what has touched it since?

A still image carries far more metadata than a video: every EXIF tag of every
IFD (camera, lens, exposure, serial numbers, owner), the GPS fix with the
compass heading of the camera, XMP with an edit history, IPTC captions and
bylines, the ICC colour profile, PNG text chunks, and an embedded thumbnail
that editors often forget to update. Each is read, cross-checked against the
others and against the file name and the pixels, and reported in plain words.
"""

import asyncio
import os
import re
import struct
from datetime import datetime
from datetime import timedelta
from datetime import timezone
from typing import Any

import cv2
import numpy as np

from earwitness import photo
from earwitness.modules.base import CaseContext
from earwitness.modules.base import Reporter
from earwitness.modules.base import Skip
from earwitness.modules.provenance import _boxes
from earwitness.modules.provenance import _reverse_geocode
from earwitness.modules.provenance import sun_position

_FILENAME_TIME = re.compile(r"(20\d{2})[-_.]?(\d{2})[-_.]?(\d{2})[-_ T.]?(\d{2})[-_.:]?(\d{2})[-_.:]?(\d{2})")
_SCREENSHOT_NAME = re.compile(r"screen\s?shot|screenshot|captura|bildschirmfoto", re.I)

# Software fingerprints in EXIF Software, XMP CreatorTool, history agents, PNG text.
_SIGNATURES: list[tuple[re.Pattern[str], str, str]] = [
    (re.compile(r"photoshop|adobe photoshop", re.I), "Adobe Photoshop", "editor"),
    (re.compile(r"lightroom", re.I), "Adobe Lightroom", "editor"),
    (re.compile(r"camera raw", re.I), "Adobe Camera Raw", "editor"),
    (re.compile(r"adobe firefly", re.I), "Adobe Firefly", "generator"),
    (re.compile(r"\bgimp\b", re.I), "GIMP", "editor"),
    (re.compile(r"snapseed", re.I), "Snapseed", "editor"),
    (re.compile(r"pixelmator", re.I), "Pixelmator", "editor"),
    (re.compile(r"affinity", re.I), "Affinity Photo", "editor"),
    (re.compile(r"luminar", re.I), "Luminar", "editor"),
    (re.compile(r"canva", re.I), "Canva", "editor"),
    (re.compile(r"picsart", re.I), "Picsart", "editor"),
    (re.compile(r"facetune", re.I), "Facetune", "editor"),
    (re.compile(r"\bvsco\b", re.I), "VSCO", "editor"),
    (re.compile(r"paint\.net", re.I), "Paint.NET", "editor"),
    (re.compile(r"capture one", re.I), "Capture One", "editor"),
    (re.compile(r"darktable|rawtherapee", re.I), "darktable / RawTherapee", "editor"),
    (re.compile(r"photos\s*\d|apple photos|photos app", re.I), "Apple Photos", "editor"),
    (re.compile(r"windows photo|microsoft photos", re.I), "Microsoft Photos", "editor"),
    (re.compile(r"google photos|photos\.google", re.I), "Google Photos", "platform"),
    (re.compile(r"picasa", re.I), "Picasa", "editor"),
    (re.compile(r"imagemagick|graphicsmagick", re.I), "ImageMagick", "editor"),
    (re.compile(r"pillow|\bPIL\b", re.I), "Python Pillow", "editor"),
    (re.compile(r"libpng|pnglib", re.I), "libpng (software export)", "editor"),
    (re.compile(r"ffmpeg|lavc|libav", re.I), "FFmpeg", "editor"),
    (re.compile(r"instagram", re.I), "Instagram", "social"),
    (re.compile(r"whatsapp", re.I), "WhatsApp", "social"),
    (re.compile(r"telegram", re.I), "Telegram", "social"),

    (re.compile(r"midjourney", re.I), "Midjourney", "generator"),
    (re.compile(r"dall[·\-\. ]?e|openai", re.I), "OpenAI (DALL·E / ChatGPT)", "generator"),
    (re.compile(r"stable diffusion|automatic1111|comfyui|invokeai|novelai|sd\s?xl|flux\.1", re.I), "Stable Diffusion / diffusion tooling", "generator"),
    (re.compile(r"\bimagen\b|gemini|synthid", re.I), "Google Imagen / Gemini", "generator"),
    (re.compile(r"leonardo\.ai|ideogram|bing image creator|microsoft designer|grok", re.I), "AI image generator", "generator"),
    (re.compile(r"screenshot|screen capture", re.I), "Screenshot tool", "screenshot"),
    (re.compile(r"\bscanner|epson scan|vuescan|canoscan", re.I), "Scanner software", "scanner"),

    (re.compile(r"^(\d{1,2}\.\d(\.\d)?)$"), "Apple iOS camera (version only)", "camera"),

]

_IDENTITY_TAGS = (
    "BodySerialNumber", "CameraOwnerName", "LensSerialNumber", "Artist", "Copyright", "ImageUniqueID",
    "OwnerName", "SerialNumber", "CameraSerialNumber", "InternalSerialNumber",
)  # fmt: skip
_IDENTITY_XMP = (
    "dc:creator", "dc:rights", "photoshop:Credit", "photoshop:AuthorsPosition", "aux:SerialNumber",
    "aux:LensSerialNumber", "aux:ImageNumber", "xmpRights:Owner", "Iptc4xmpCore:CreatorContactInfo",
    "Iptc4xmpCore:CiEmailWork", "Iptc4xmpCore:CiTelWork", "Iptc4xmpCore:CiAdrCity", "exif:CameraOwnerName",
    "exif:BodySerialNumber", "exifEX:BodySerialNumber", "exifEX:CameraOwnerName", "exifEX:LensSerialNumber",
