)  # fmt: skip

# Common phone screen sizes (portrait) that mark a screenshot when a PNG has no camera data.
_SCREENS = {
    (1170, 2532), (1179, 2556), (1206, 2622), (1284, 2778), (1290, 2796), (1320, 2868), (1125, 2436), (1242, 2688),
    (828, 1792), (750, 1334), (1080, 1920), (1080, 2340), (1080, 2400), (1440, 3200), (1440, 3120), (1440, 3088),
    (1080, 2316), (1080, 2408), (1080, 2412), (1080, 2436), (1344, 2992), (1080, 2424), (1216, 2688),
}  # fmt: skip


def _icc_description(icc: bytes | None) -> str | None:
    if not icc or len(icc) < 132:
        return None

    try:
        count = struct.unpack(">I", icc[128:132])[0]

        for index in range(min(count, 100)):
            base = 132 + index * 12
            sig, offset, size = struct.unpack(">4sII", icc[base : base + 12])

            if sig != b"desc" or offset + size > len(icc):
                continue

            block = icc[offset : offset + size]

            if block[:4] == b"desc":
                length = struct.unpack(">I", block[8:12])[0]

                return block[12 : 12 + length].split(b"\x00", 1)[0].decode("latin-1", "replace").strip()

            if block[:4] == b"mluc":
                records = struct.unpack(">I", block[8:12])[0]

                if records:
                    length, rel = struct.unpack(">II", block[20:28])

                    return block[rel : rel + length].decode("utf-16-be", "replace").strip("\x00 ")
    except struct.error:
        return None

    return None


_IPTC_NAMES = {
    5: "title", 25: "keywords", 55: "date created", 60: "time created", 80: "by-line", 85: "by-line title",
    90: "city", 92: "sub-location", 95: "province/state", 101: "country", 105: "headline", 110: "credit",
    115: "source", 116: "copyright", 120: "caption", 122: "caption writer", 103: "job id", 40: "special instructions",
}  # fmt: skip


def _iptc(blob: bytes | None) -> dict[str, str]:
    out: dict[str, str] = {}

    if not blob:
        return out

    offset = 0

    while offset + 5 <= len(blob):
        if blob[offset] != 0x1C:
            offset += 1

            continue

        record, dataset = blob[offset + 1], blob[offset + 2]
        size = struct.unpack(">H", blob[offset + 3 : offset + 5])[0]

        if size & 0x8000:
            break

        value = blob[offset + 5 : offset + 5 + size].decode("utf-8", "replace")

        if record == 2 and value.strip():
            name = _IPTC_NAMES.get(dataset, f"2:{dataset}")
            out[name] = (out[name] + "; " + value) if name in out else value

        offset += 5 + size

    return out


def _exposure_words(exif: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    bits = []
    exposure = exif.get("ExposureTime")

    if isinstance(exposure, (int, float)) and exposure > 0:
        bits.append(f"1/{round(1 / exposure)} s" if exposure < 1 else f"{exposure:g} s")

    fnumber = exif.get("FNumber")

    if isinstance(fnumber, (int, float)) and fnumber > 0:
        bits.append(f"f/{fnumber:.1f}")

    iso = exif.get("ISOSpeedRatings") or exif.get("PhotographicSensitivity")

    if isinstance(iso, (tuple, list)):
        iso = iso[0] if iso else None

    if isinstance(iso, (int, float)):
        bits.append(f"ISO {int(iso)}")

    focal = exif.get("FocalLength")
    equiv = exif.get("FocalLengthIn35mmFilm")

    if isinstance(focal, (int, float)) and focal > 0:
        bits.append(f"{focal:.1f} mm" + (f" ({int(equiv)} mm equivalent)" if isinstance(equiv, (int, float)) and equiv else ""))

    zoom = exif.get("DigitalZoomRatio")

    if isinstance(zoom, (int, float)) and zoom > 1.05:
        bits.append(f"digital zoom {zoom:.2f}×")

    flash = exif.get("Flash")

    if isinstance(flash, int):
        bits.append("flash fired" if flash & 1 else "no flash")

    return ", ".join(bits)


def _software_hits(texts: list[str]) -> list[tuple[str, str, str]]:
    seen: list[tuple[str, str, str]] = []

    for text in texts:
        if not text:
            continue

        for pattern, label, role in _SIGNATURES:
            if pattern.search(text) and all(label != s[0] for s in seen):
                seen.append((label, role, text[:160]))

    return seen


def _thumbnail_check(thumb: np.ndarray, image: np.ndarray) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Compare the embedded thumbnail with the picture it claims to represent."""
    th, tw = thumb.shape[:2]
    small = cv2.resize(image, (tw, th), interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA)
    a = cv2.cvtColor(small, cv2.COLOR_RGB2GRAY).astype(np.float32)
    b = cv2.cvtColor(thumb, cv2.COLOR_RGB2GRAY).astype(np.float32)
    a = (a - a.mean()) / (a.std() + 1e-6)
    b = (b - b.mean()) / (b.std() + 1e-6)
    correlation = float((a * b).mean())
    diff = cv2.absdiff(cv2.GaussianBlur(small, (0, 0), 1.5), cv2.GaussianBlur(thumb, (0, 0), 1.5))
    diff_gray = cv2.cvtColor(diff, cv2.COLOR_RGB2GRAY).astype(np.float32)
    aspect_image = image.shape[1] / image.shape[0]
    aspect_thumb = tw / th

    return {
        "correlation": correlation,
        "mean_difference": float(diff_gray.mean()),
        "aspect_image": aspect_image,
        "aspect_thumb": aspect_thumb,
        "aspect_mismatch": abs(aspect_image - aspect_thumb) / aspect_image > 0.04,
        "diff_map": diff_gray,
    }


class PhotoProvenance:
    name = "provenance"
    title = "PHOTO PROVENANCE"
    description = "EXIF, XMP, IPTC, ICC and PNG metadata: camera, lens, serial numbers, GPS with compass heading, timestamps, edit history, embedded thumbnail."

    async def run(self, ctx: CaseContext, out: Reporter) -> None:
        image = ctx.image()
        info = ctx.image_info()

        if image is None or info is None:
            raise Skip("not a decodable image")

        from earwitness import photo as _photo

        loaded = _photo.load(ctx.path)

        if loaded is None:
            raise Skip("not a decodable image")

        with open(ctx.path, "rb") as handle:
            data = handle.read()

        out.progress(0.1, "reading metadata")
        exif = photo.parse_exif(loaded.exif)
        xmp = photo.parse_xmp(loaded.xmp)
        iptc = _iptc(loaded.iptc)
        icc_name = _icc_description(loaded.icc)
        ifd0 = exif.ifds.get("IFD0", {}) if exif else {}
        exif_ifd = exif.ifds.get("Exif", {}) if exif else {}
        gps_ifd = exif.ifds.get("GPS", {}) if exif else {}
        xmp_fields = xmp.fields if xmp else {}
        filename = ctx.options.get("original_name") or os.path.basename(ctx.path)
        published: dict[str, Any] = {"kind": "image"}

        # ---- raw tables -----------------------------------------------------------------
        rows: list[list[Any]] = []

        if exif:
            for ifd, tag, name, value in exif.raw_tags:
                rows.append([f"EXIF {ifd}", f"0x{tag:04X}", name, _show(value)])

        for key, value in xmp_fields.items():
            rows.append(["XMP", "", key, value[:300]])

        for key, value in iptc.items():
            rows.append(["IPTC", "", key, value[:300]])

        for key, value in loaded.text.items():
            rows.append([f"{info.format} text", "", key, value[:500]])

        if icc_name:
            rows.append(["ICC", "", "profile description", icc_name])

        out.artifact(
            "tags", "table", "Every label stored in the file",
            data={"columns": ["where", "tag", "name", "value"], "rows": rows[:600]},
        )  # fmt: skip
        report = {
            "format": info.format, "mode": info.mode, "bits": info.bits, "frames": info.frames,
            "stored_size": [info.stored_width, info.stored_height], "oriented_size": [info.width, info.height],
            "orientation": info.orientation, "exif": exif.ifds if exif else None,
            "exif_byte_order": exif.byte_order if exif else None, "makernote": exif.makernote if exif else None,
            "xmp": xmp_fields or None, "xmp_history": xmp.history if xmp else None,
            "xmp_derived_from": xmp.derived_from if xmp else None, "iptc": iptc or None,
            "icc_profile": icc_name, "icc_bytes": len(loaded.icc or b""), "text_chunks": loaded.text or None,
            "pillow_info": loaded.pil_info,
        }  # fmt: skip
        out.artifact("probe", "json", "Raw metadata report", data=report)

        # ---- file layout --------------------------------------------------------------------
        out.progress(0.2, "mapping the file layout")
        layout_rows: list[list[Any]] = []
        jpeg = photo.jpeg_anatomy(data) if data[:2] == b"\xff\xd8" else None
        png = photo.png_anatomy(data) if data[:8] == b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n" else None

        if jpeg:
            layout_rows = [[s["offset"], s.get("app") or s["name"], s["length"], s.get("text", "") or (f"{s['scan_bytes']:,} bytes of image data" if "scan_bytes" in s else "")] for s in jpeg.segments]
        elif png:
            layout_rows = [[c["offset"], c["type"], c["length"], ""] for c in png.chunks if c["type"] != "IDAT"]
            idat = [c for c in png.chunks if c["type"] == "IDAT"]

            if idat:
                layout_rows.append([idat[0]["offset"], f"IDAT × {len(idat)}", sum(c["length"] for c in idat), "compressed pixel data"])
        elif data[4:8] == b"ftyp":
            boxes = await asyncio.to_thread(_boxes, ctx.path)
            layout_rows = [[b["offset"], ("  " * b["depth"]) + b["type"], b["size"], ""] for b in boxes[:200]]

        if layout_rows:
            out.artifact(
                "boxes", "table", "File layout (segments, chunks or boxes)",
                data={"columns": ["offset", "part", "bytes", "note"], "rows": layout_rows},
            )  # fmt: skip

        # ---- device, lens, exposure ----------------------------------------------------------
        make = _text(ifd0.get("Make")) or _text(xmp_fields.get("tiff:Make"))
        model = _text(ifd0.get("Model")) or _text(xmp_fields.get("tiff:Model"))
        software = _text(ifd0.get("Software")) or _text(xmp_fields.get("xmp:CreatorTool")) or _text(loaded.text.get("Software"))
        lens = _text(exif_ifd.get("LensModel")) or _text(xmp_fields.get("aux:Lens")) or _text(xmp_fields.get("exifEX:LensModel"))
        exposure = _exposure_words(exif_ifd)
        published.update({"make": make, "model": model, "software": software, "lens": lens})

        if make or model:
            device = " ".join(dict.fromkeys(x for x in (make, model) if x))
            out.finding(
                "info",
                f"Taken on {device}",
                f"The camera tags name the device{f', lens {lens}' if lens else ''}{f'; {exposure}' if exposure else ''}"
                f"{f'; software {software}' if software else ''}. These labels are written by the camera and can be edited.",
                tags=["device"],
                data={"make": make, "model": model, "lens": lens, "software": software, "exposure": exposure or None,
                      "makernote": exif.makernote if exif else None},
            )  # fmt: skip

        if exif and exif.makernote and (make or model):
            out.finding(
                "info",
                f"Maker notes from {exif.makernote['vendor_prefix']} intact ({exif.makernote['size_bytes']:,} bytes)",
                "The manufacturer's private block survives. Most editors and messaging apps drop or damage it, "
                "so its presence is consistent with a camera original (or a careful copy).",
                tags=["metadata", "camera"],
                data=exif.makernote,
            )

        # ---- identity: serials, owner, bylines ------------------------------------------------
        identity: dict[str, str] = {}

        for tag in _IDENTITY_TAGS:
            for ifd in (ifd0, exif_ifd):
                value = _text(ifd.get(tag))

                if value and value.lower() not in ("0", "none", "unknown"):
                    identity[tag] = value

        for key in _IDENTITY_XMP:
            value = _text(xmp_fields.get(key))

            if value:
                identity[key] = value

        for key in ("by-line", "copyright", "credit", "caption writer", "source"):
            if iptc.get(key):
                identity[f"IPTC {key}"] = iptc[key]

        for key in ("Author", "Artist", "Copyright", "Creator"):
            if loaded.text.get(key):
                identity[f"PNG {key}"] = loaded.text[key]

        if identity:
            serials = {k: v for k, v in identity.items() if "serial" in k.lower() or k == "ImageUniqueID"}
            names = {k: v for k, v in identity.items() if k not in serials}
            out.finding(
                "critical" if names else "warning",
                ("Name in the file: " + "; ".join(list(names.values())[:2])) if names else "Camera serial number stored in the file",
                "The metadata carries " + ", ".join(f"{k} = “{v}”" for k, v in list(identity.items())[:6]) + ". "
                + ("A name or copyright line identifies the photographer directly. " if names else "")
                + ("A serial number ties every photo from this camera together and can be matched to purchase or repair records." if serials else ""),
                tags=["identity", "metadata", "privacy"],
                data=identity,
            )

        # ---- software --------------------------------------------------------------------------
        out.progress(0.35, "fingerprinting software")
        agents = [h.get("softwareAgent", "") for h in (xmp.history if xmp else [])]
        texts = [software or "", xmp_fields.get("xmp:CreatorTool", ""), *agents, loaded.text.get("Software", ""),
                 loaded.text.get("Comment", ""), loaded.text.get("comment", ""), " ".join(jpeg.comments) if jpeg else "",
                 xmp_fields.get("photoshop:History", ""), *[a for a in (jpeg.app_names if jpeg else [])]]  # fmt: skip
        hits = _software_hits(texts)
        published["software_seen"] = sorted(label for label, _, _ in hits)
        published["generators"] = [label for label, role, _ in hits if role == "generator"]

        for label, role, evidence in hits:
            if role == "camera":
                continue

            severity = "warning" if role in ("editor", "generator") else "notice"
            explanation = {
                "editor": "Camera originals name only the camera firmware; this file names editing software, so it was re-saved by that program (which does not by itself prove the picture was altered).",
                "social": "Messaging and social apps re-encode every picture and strip most metadata; this copy came through one.",
                "platform": "A photo platform exported or re-saved this copy.",
                "generator": "The metadata names an AI image generator. See the AI generation signals check.",
                "screenshot": "This file is a screenshot, not a photograph taken with a camera.",
                "scanner": "This image was scanned from paper or film.",
            }[role]
            out.finding(
                severity,
                f"{'Generated with' if role == 'generator' else 'Processed by'} {label}",
                f"{explanation} Evidence: “{evidence}”.",
                tags=["software", role] + (["editor"] if role == "generator" else []),
                data={"software": label, "role": role, "evidence": evidence},
            )

        if xmp and xmp.history:
            out.artifact(
                "history", "table", "Edit history recorded in XMP",
                data={
                    "columns": ["when", "action", "software", "parameters", "changed"],
                    "rows": [[h.get("when", ""), h.get("action", ""), h.get("softwareAgent", ""), h.get("parameters", ""), h.get("changed", "")] for h in xmp.history],
                },
            )  # fmt: skip
            steps = [f"{h.get('action', '?')} ({h.get('softwareAgent', 'unknown software')}{', ' + h['when'][:19] if h.get('when') else ''})" for h in xmp.history]
            out.finding(
                "warning",
                f"Edit history: {len(xmp.history)} recorded step{'s' if len(xmp.history) != 1 else ''}",
                "The XMP block keeps a log written by Adobe-style software: " + "; ".join(steps[:6]) + ". "
                "This is the software's own account of what was done and when; it can be stripped but rarely forged.",
                tags=["software", "editor", "history"],
                data={"history": xmp.history},
            )

        if xmp and xmp.derived_from:
            out.finding(
                "notice",
                "Derived from another file",
                "XMP says this image was derived from " + ", ".join(f"{k} {v}" for k, v in list(xmp.derived_from.items())[:3]) + ".",
                tags=["software", "history"],
                data=xmp.derived_from,
            )

        # ---- screenshot ------------------------------------------------------------------------
        screenshot_words = any(
            _SCREENSHOT_NAME.search(str(v)) for v in (filename, ifd0.get("ImageDescription"), exif_ifd.get("UserComment"), xmp_fields.get("exif:UserComment"), xmp_fields.get("dc:description"))
        )
        screen_size = (info.width, info.height) in _SCREENS or (info.height, info.width) in _SCREENS
        is_screenshot = screenshot_words or (screen_size and not make and info.format == "PNG")
        published["screenshot"] = is_screenshot

        if is_screenshot:
            out.finding(
                "notice",
                "This is a screenshot",
                ("The file labels itself a screenshot. " if screenshot_words else f"A {info.width}×{info.height} PNG with no camera data matches a phone screen exactly. ")
                + "Nothing in it was captured through a lens, so camera and lighting checks do not apply; the content shown may itself be real or not.",
                tags=["screenshot", "metadata"],
                data={"width": info.width, "height": info.height, "by_label": screenshot_words, "by_size": screen_size},
            )

        # ---- dimensions and orientation -------------------------------------------------------
        exif_w, exif_h = exif_ifd.get("ExifImageWidth"), exif_ifd.get("ExifImageHeight")

        if isinstance(exif_w, int) and isinstance(exif_h, int) and exif_w > 0 and exif_h > 0:
            stored = {info.stored_width, info.stored_height}

            if stored != {exif_w, exif_h}:
                ratio = info.stored_width * info.stored_height / (exif_w * exif_h)
                out.finding(
                    "warning",
                    f"Resized or cropped after capture: {exif_w}×{exif_h} became {info.stored_width}×{info.stored_height}",
                    f"The camera recorded the picture as {exif_w}×{exif_h} pixels, but the file holds {info.stored_width}×{info.stored_height} "
                    f"({ratio * 100:.0f}% of the original pixel count). Something re-sampled or cropped it and kept the old labels.",
                    tags=["resized", "inconsistency", "software"],
                    data={"exif_size": [exif_w, exif_h], "stored_size": [info.stored_width, info.stored_height], "pixel_ratio": ratio},
                )

        if info.orientation != 1:
            out.finding(
                "info",
                f"Stored rotated (orientation {info.orientation}); shown upright",
                "The camera saved the sensor image as-is and recorded how to rotate it. Every measurement here is on the upright picture.",
                tags=["metadata"],
                data={"orientation": info.orientation, "stored": [info.stored_width, info.stored_height]},
            )

        # ---- time -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        out.progress(0.5, "reconciling clocks")
        offset_original = exif_ifd.get("OffsetTimeOriginal") or exif_ifd.get("OffsetTime")
        original = photo.exif_datetime(exif_ifd.get("DateTimeOriginal"), offset_original, exif_ifd.get("SubsecTimeOriginal"))
        digitized = photo.exif_datetime(exif_ifd.get("DateTimeDigitized"), exif_ifd.get("OffsetTimeDigitized") or offset_original)
        modified = photo.exif_datetime(ifd0.get("DateTime"), exif_ifd.get("OffsetTime") or offset_original)
        xmp_create = _iso(xmp_fields.get("xmp:CreateDate") or xmp_fields.get("photoshop:DateCreated"))
        xmp_modify = _iso(xmp_fields.get("xmp:ModifyDate"))
        xmp_metadata = _iso(xmp_fields.get("xmp:MetadataDate"))
        png_time = _iso(loaded.text.get("Creation Time")) or _iso(loaded.text.get("date:create"))
        fix = photo.gps_fix(gps_ifd)
        gps_time = fix.time_utc if fix and fix.time_utc and fix.time_utc.year > 1900 else None
        file_local = None
        found = _FILENAME_TIME.search(filename)

        if found:
            try:
                file_local = datetime(*(int(g) for g in found.groups()))
            except ValueError:
                file_local = None

        times: dict[str, Any] = {
            "date_time_original": original, "date_time_digitized": digitized, "modify_date": modified,
            "offset_time_original": offset_original, "gps_time_utc": gps_time, "xmp_create_date": xmp_create,
            "xmp_modify_date": xmp_modify, "xmp_metadata_date": xmp_metadata, "png_creation_time": png_time,
            "filename_local": file_local, "copy_stamp": False,
        }  # fmt: skip
        time_rows = [[k.replace("_", " "), v.isoformat() if isinstance(v, datetime) else (v or "")] for k, v in times.items() if v not in (None, False, "")]

        if time_rows:
            out.artifact("clocks", "table", "Every clock in the file", data={"columns": ["clock", "value"], "rows": time_rows})

        taken = original or digitized or xmp_create or png_time
        offset_h: float | None = None

        if isinstance(offset_original, str) and (m := re.match(r"^([+-])(\d{2}):?(\d{2})$", offset_original.strip())):
            offset_h = (1 if m.group(1) == "+" else -1) * (int(m.group(2)) + int(m.group(3)) / 60)

        # Local wall clock vs GPS UTC gives the time zone, as the filename did for video.
        if taken is not None and taken.tzinfo is None and gps_time is not None:
            delta_h = (taken - gps_time.replace(tzinfo=None)).total_seconds() / 3600
            rounded = round(delta_h * 4) / 4
            residual = abs(delta_h - rounded) * 3600

            if residual <= 90 and abs(rounded) <= 14:
                offset_h = rounded
                taken = taken.replace(tzinfo=timezone(timedelta(hours=rounded)))
                out.finding(
                    "notice",
                    f"Local clock was UTC{rounded:+g}",
                    f"The camera clock says {original or taken:%H:%M:%S} local and the GPS receiver stamped {gps_time:%H:%M:%S} UTC within "
                    f"{residual:.0f} s, so the phone was set to UTC{rounded:+g} where it took the picture. That narrows the region on its own.",
                    tags=["time", "timezone"],
                    data={"offset_h": rounded, "residual_s": residual},
                )
            else:
                out.finding(
                    "warning",
                    "Camera clock and GPS clock disagree",
                    f"The camera says {taken} and the GPS receiver {gps_time:%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S} UTC; no whole time-zone offset reconciles them "
                    f"(nearest leaves {residual:.0f} s). A clock was wrong or the date was edited.",
                    tags=["time", "inconsistency"],
                    data={"residual_s": residual},
                )
        elif taken is not None and taken.tzinfo is not None and gps_time is not None:
            gap = abs((taken - gps_time).total_seconds())

            if gap > 120:
                out.finding(
                    "warning",
                    f"Camera clock {gap / 60:.0f} min away from the GPS clock",
                    f"The camera stamped {taken.isoformat()} and the GPS receiver {gps_time.isoformat()}. Phones keep these within seconds; a gap this size means the date or time was edited, or the GPS fix is stale.",
                    tags=["time", "inconsistency"],
                    data={"gap_s": gap},
                )

        if taken is not None:
            when_utc = taken.astimezone(timezone.utc) if taken.tzinfo else taken.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
            local_text = f"{taken:%A %-d %B %Y, %H:%M:%S}" + (f" (UTC{offset_h:+g})" if offset_h is not None else " (time zone not stated)")
            out.finding(
                "info",
                f"Taken {taken:%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S}" + (f" UTC{offset_h:+g}" if offset_h is not None else " (local clock)"),
                f"DateTimeOriginal: {local_text}. "
                + ("Converted to UTC it is " + f"{when_utc:%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S}. " if offset_h is not None else "Without a stated zone the hour is only as good as the phone's clock. ")
                + "A camera writes this at the moment of capture; editors copy it, so it is a claim, not a measurement.",
                tags=["time"],
                data={k: v for k, v in times.items() if v is not None},
            )

        if original and digitized and abs((original.replace(tzinfo=None) - digitized.replace(tzinfo=None)).total_seconds()) > 2:
            out.finding(
                "notice",
                "Taken and digitised at different times",
                f"DateTimeOriginal {original} but DateTimeDigitized {digitized}. Cameras write both the same; a scan, import or re-save sets them apart.",
                tags=["time", "metadata"],
                data={"original": original, "digitized": digitized},
            )

        latest_modify = max((t for t in (modified, xmp_modify, xmp_metadata) if t is not None), key=lambda t: t.replace(tzinfo=None), default=None)

        if taken is not None and latest_modify is not None:
            gap_s = (latest_modify.replace(tzinfo=None) - taken.replace(tzinfo=None)).total_seconds()

            if gap_s > 5:
                out.finding(
                    "warning",
                    f"Modified {_span(gap_s)} after it was taken",
                    f"The modification clock reads {latest_modify}, {_span(gap_s)} after the capture time {taken}. Cameras write both identical; a later value means the file was opened and saved by software.",
                    tags=["software", "modified", "time"],
                    data={"taken": taken, "modified": latest_modify, "gap_s": gap_s},
                )

        if taken is not None and file_local is not None:
            naive = taken.replace(tzinfo=None)
            delta_h = (file_local - naive).total_seconds() / 3600
            rounded = round(delta_h * 4) / 4
            residual = abs(delta_h - rounded) * 3600

            if residual > 5 or abs(rounded) > 14:
                out.finding(
                    "warning",
                    "File name and camera clock disagree",
                    f"The name {filename} encodes {file_local}, the camera clock {naive}. Phones name files from the same clock; the file was renamed or the date edited.",
                    tags=["time", "inconsistency"],
                    data={"filename_time": file_local, "camera_time": naive},
                )
            elif rounded != 0 and offset_h is None:
                out.finding(
                    "notice",
                    f"File name clock is UTC{rounded:+g} from the camera clock",
                    f"The file name encodes {file_local}, the camera clock {naive}: a {rounded:+g} h difference, as when one is UTC and the other local.",
                    tags=["time", "timezone"],
                    data={"offset_h": rounded},
                )

        if not exif or not (ifd0 or exif_ifd):
            out.finding(
                "notice",
                "Metadata stripped",
                "No EXIF block: no camera, no date, no GPS. Social platforms, messaging apps and web downloads strip these; camera originals carry a few kilobytes of them."
                + (" Only a bare JFIF header remains, the signature of a generic re-encode." if jpeg and jpeg.jfif and not jpeg.exif_first else ""),
                tags=["metadata"],
                data={"format": info.format, "app_segments": jpeg.app_names if jpeg else None},
            )

        if taken is None and latest_modify is not None and not (make or model):
            age_h = (datetime.now(timezone.utc) - (latest_modify if latest_modify.tzinfo else latest_modify.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc))).total_seconds() / 3600

            if -1 <= age_h <= 72:
                times["copy_stamp"] = True
                out.finding(
                    "warning",
                    "Timestamp is when this copy was made",
                    f"The only date in the file is {latest_modify}, {max(age_h, 0):.1f} h before it was examined, with no camera named. That is the moment an app saved this copy, not when it was taken.",
                    tags=["time", "metadata"],
                    data={"age_hours": age_h},
                )

        published["times"] = times
        start_guess = None

        if taken is not None and not times["copy_stamp"]:
            start_guess = taken.astimezone(timezone.utc) if taken.tzinfo else taken.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)

        published["start_guess"] = start_guess
        published["start_candidates"] = [start_guess] if start_guess else []
        published["tz_known"] = offset_h is not None

        # ---- place --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        out.progress(0.7, "locating")
        published["location"] = None

        if fix is None and xmp_fields.get("exif:GPSLatitude") and xmp_fields.get("exif:GPSLongitude"):
            fix = _xmp_gps(xmp_fields)

        if fix:
            place = await _reverse_geocode(fix.lat, fix.lon)
            published["location"] = {
                "lat": fix.lat, "lon": fix.lon, "alt_m": fix.alt_m, "accuracy_m": fix.accuracy_m, "place": place,
                "heading_deg": fix.heading_deg, "speed_kmh": fix.speed_kmh,
            }  # fmt: skip
            detail = (f"{place}. " if place else "") + "The file carries the phone's GPS fix"
            detail += f" (±{fix.accuracy_m:.0f} m)" if fix.accuracy_m else ""
            detail += f", altitude {fix.alt_m:.0f} m" if fix.alt_m is not None else ""

            if fix.heading_deg is not None:
                detail += f". The camera pointed {photo.compass(fix.heading_deg)} ({fix.heading_deg:.0f}°), so the scene lies in that direction from the dot on the map"

            if fix.speed_kmh is not None and fix.speed_kmh > 2:
                detail += f". The phone was moving at {fix.speed_kmh:.0f} km/h"

            out.finding(
                "critical",
                f"GPS fix: {fix.lat:.5f}, {fix.lon:.5f}",
                detail + ". Anyone with this file can see exactly where the photographer stood.",
                tags=["location", "gps", "privacy"],
                data=published["location"],
            )
            out.artifact(
                "map", "map", "Where the photographer stood",
                data={"points": [{"lat": fix.lat, "lon": fix.lon, "label": "GPS (metadata)", "accuracy_m": fix.accuracy_m,
                                  "kind": "gps", "heading_deg": fix.heading_deg}]},
            )  # fmt: skip

            if start_guess is not None:
                elevation, azimuth = sun_position(start_guess, fix.lat, fix.lon)
                phase = ("daylight" if elevation > 6 else "golden hour / civil twilight" if elevation > -6
                         else "nautical twilight" if elevation > -12 else "night")  # fmt: skip
                published["sun"] = {"elevation": elevation, "azimuth": azimuth, "phase": phase}
                words = f"Computed from the claimed time and GPS fix: the sun was at {elevation:+.0f}° ({phase}), azimuth {azimuth:.0f}° ({photo.compass(azimuth)})."

                if fix.heading_deg is not None and elevation > 0:
                    relative = ((azimuth - fix.heading_deg + 180) % 360) - 180
                    side = ("in front of the camera: a backlit scene, shadows reaching toward the photographer" if abs(relative) < 45
                            else "behind the camera: shadows point away into the scene" if abs(relative) > 135
                            else f"to the camera's {'right' if relative > 0 else 'left'}: shadows should fall toward the {'left' if relative > 0 else 'right'} of the frame")  # fmt: skip
                    words += f" With the camera pointing {photo.compass(fix.heading_deg)}, the sun was {side}. Shadows that disagree mean the time, place or picture is wrong."
                    published["sun"]["relative_deg"] = relative
                elif elevation <= 0:
                    words += " It was dark there then; a bright daylight scene would contradict the stated time or place."

                out.finding(
                    "info",
                    f"Sun {elevation:+.0f}° high, {photo.compass(azimuth)} ({phase})",
                    words,
                    tags=["sun", "time", "location"],
                    data=published["sun"],
                )

        if iptc.get("city") or iptc.get("country") or xmp_fields.get("photoshop:City") or xmp_fields.get("Iptc4xmpExt:LocationShown"):
            place_words = ", ".join(str(v) for v in (iptc.get("sub-location"), iptc.get("city"), iptc.get("province/state"), iptc.get("country"), xmp_fields.get("photoshop:City"), xmp_fields.get("photoshop:Country")) if v)
            out.finding(
                "warning",
                f"Place written in the caption data: {place_words}",
                "IPTC/XMP location fields were typed by a person or tool, not measured. They still tell a reader where the author says it was taken.",
                tags=["location", "metadata"],
                data={"place": place_words},
            )

        # ---- captions, keywords, descriptions -----------------------------------------------------
        caption = iptc.get("caption") or xmp_fields.get("dc:description") or _text(ifd0.get("ImageDescription")) or loaded.text.get("Description") or loaded.text.get("Comment")

        if caption and not is_screenshot and len(caption) > 3:
            out.finding(
                "notice",
                f"Caption in the file: “{caption[:90]}{'…' if len(caption) > 90 else ''}”",
                "Descriptive text stored inside the file" + (f"; keywords: {iptc.get('keywords') or xmp_fields.get('dc:subject')}" if iptc.get("keywords") or xmp_fields.get("dc:subject") else "") + ". Written by a person or an app; it travels with every copy.",
                tags=["metadata", "text"],
                data={"caption": caption[:1000], "keywords": iptc.get("keywords") or xmp_fields.get("dc:subject")},
            )

        if icc_name:
            out.finding(
                "info",
                f"Colour profile: {icc_name}",
                "The embedded ICC profile names the colour space. Phones write Display P3 or sRGB; Adobe RGB or ProPhoto point to a camera-raw workflow or an editor."
                + (" A profile this large usually comes from editing software, not a phone." if loaded.icc and len(loaded.icc) > 4000 else ""),
                tags=["metadata", "colour"],
                data={"profile": icc_name, "bytes": len(loaded.icc or b"")},
            )

        # ---- embedded thumbnail -----------------------------------------------------------------
        out.progress(0.85, "checking the embedded thumbnail")

        if exif and exif.thumbnail:
            thumb = photo.jpeg_from_bytes(exif.thumbnail)

            if thumb is not None and thumb.size:
                upright = thumb

                # The thumbnail is stored unrotated, like the main image.
                if info.orientation != 1:
                    from PIL import ImageOps

                    pil = photo.pil_from(thumb)
                    pil.getexif()[0x0112] = info.orientation
                    upright = np.asarray(ImageOps.exif_transpose(pil).convert("RGB"))

                check = await asyncio.to_thread(_thumbnail_check, upright, image)
                th, tw = upright.shape[:2]
                scale = 3
                big = cv2.resize(upright, (tw * scale, th * scale), interpolation=cv2.INTER_NEAREST)
                now = cv2.resize(image, (tw * scale, th * scale), interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA)
                heat = cv2.resize(np.clip(check["diff_map"] / 60.0, 0, 1).astype(np.float32), (tw * scale, th * scale))
                diff_vis = cv2.applyColorMap((heat * 255).astype(np.uint8), cv2.COLORMAP_INFERNO)
                panel = np.concatenate([cv2.cvtColor(big, cv2.COLOR_RGB2BGR), cv2.cvtColor(now, cv2.COLOR_RGB2BGR), diff_vis], axis=1)
                path = out.path("thumbnail_compare.jpg")
                photo.save_bgr(path, panel, 90)
                out.artifact(
                    "thumbnail", "image", "Embedded thumbnail (left) vs the picture now (middle) and their difference (right)",
                    file=path, data={"caption": f"Thumbnail {tw}×{th} px, written by the camera; correlation {check['correlation']:.2f}"},
                )  # fmt: skip
                mismatch = check["correlation"] < 0.75 or check["aspect_mismatch"]

                if mismatch:
                    out.finding(
                        "critical" if check["correlation"] < 0.5 else "warning",
                        "Embedded thumbnail shows a different picture",
                        f"The camera wrote a small preview into the EXIF block when it took the photo. It matches the picture only {check['correlation'] * 100:.0f}%"
                        + (f" and has a different shape ({check['aspect_thumb']:.2f} vs {check['aspect_image']:.2f})" if check["aspect_mismatch"] else "")
                        + ". Editors that change the pixels but keep the metadata leave the old preview behind: the thumbnail is what the photo looked like before.",
                        tags=["thumbnail", "inconsistency", "edited", "splice"],
                        data={k: v for k, v in check.items() if k != "diff_map"},
                    )
                else:
                    out.finding(
                        "info",
                        f"Embedded thumbnail matches the picture ({check['correlation'] * 100:.0f}%)",
                        "The preview the camera wrote at capture agrees with the full picture, which argues against pixel edits that kept the metadata.",
                        tags=["thumbnail"],
                        data={k: v for k, v in check.items() if k != "diff_map"},
                    )

        published["exif_present"] = bool(exif and (ifd0 or exif_ifd))
        published["is_jpeg"] = jpeg is not None
        published["identity"] = identity
        ctx.publish(self.name, published)
        out.progress(1.0)


def _text(value: Any) -> str | None:
    if value is None:
        return None

    text = str(value).strip().strip("\x00")

    return text or None


def _show(value: Any) -> str:
    if isinstance(value, float):
        return f"{value:.6g}"

    if isinstance(value, (tuple, list)):
        return ", ".join(_show(v) for v in value[:16]) + (" …" if len(value) > 16 else "")

    return str(value)[:300]


def _iso(text: str | None) -> datetime | None:
    if not text:
        return None

    cleaned = text.strip().replace("Z", "+00:00")

    try:
        parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(cleaned)
    except ValueError:
        return photo.exif_datetime(cleaned)

    return parsed


def _span(seconds: float) -> str:
    if seconds < 90:
        return f"{seconds:.0f} s"

    if seconds < 5400:
        return f"{seconds / 60:.0f} min"

    if seconds < 172800:
        return f"{seconds / 3600:.1f} h"

    return f"{seconds / 86400:.0f} days"


def _xmp_gps(fields: dict[str, str]) -> photo.GpsFix | None:
    """XMP writes GPS as '48,51.7103N'."""

    def parse(text: str) -> float | None:
        m = re.match(r"^\s*(\d+),([\d.]+)([NSEW])\s*$", text)

        if not m:
            return None

        value = int(m.group(1)) + float(m.group(2)) / 60

        return -value if m.group(3) in "SW" else value

    lat = parse(fields.get("exif:GPSLatitude", ""))
    lon = parse(fields.get("exif:GPSLongitude", ""))

    if lat is None or lon is None:
        return None

    return photo.GpsFix(lat=lat, lon=lon, alt_m=None, time_utc=None, heading_deg=None, speed_kmh=None, accuracy_m=None)

"""The anatomy of the compression: what the encoder left behind.

A JPEG's quantisation tables say how hard it was compressed and which software
did it; its segment order, Huffman tables and chroma subsampling say whether a
camera or an editor wrote it. Recompressing the picture at every quality and
watching the error ("JPEG ghosts") reveals an earlier save at a different
quality, overall or in one pasted region. The 8×8 block grid that JPEG leaves
in the pixels can be found even in a PNG, and a region whose grid is shifted
was pasted in from another JPEG.
"""

import asyncio
from typing import Any

import cv2
import numpy as np

from earwitness import photo
from earwitness.modules.base import CaseContext
from earwitness.modules.base import Reporter
from earwitness.modules.base import Skip
from earwitness.modules.base import downsample_series

_GHOST_QUALITIES = list(range(30, 101, 2))
_GHOST_CROP = 1024
_GRID_TILE = 96


def _aligned_crops(gray: np.ndarray, size: int, count: int = 4) -> list[tuple[int, int]]:
    """Top-left corners (multiples of 8) of up to ``count`` crops spread over the image."""
    h, w = gray.shape[:2]
    size = min(size, h - h % 8, w - w % 8)

    if size < 64:
        return [(0, 0)]

    if h <= size and w <= size:
        return [(0, 0)]

    ys = np.linspace(0, h - size, 2).astype(int) // 8 * 8
    xs = np.linspace(0, w - size, 2).astype(int) // 8 * 8
    corners = sorted({(int(y), int(x)) for y in ys for x in xs})

    return corners[:count]


def ghost_curve(rgb: np.ndarray) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Mean squared recompression error at each quality, averaged over aligned crops."""
    corners = _aligned_crops(rgb, _GHOST_CROP)
    size = min(_GHOST_CROP, rgb.shape[0] - rgb.shape[0] % 8, rgb.shape[1] - rgb.shape[1] % 8)
    crops = [rgb[y : y + size, x : x + size] for y, x in corners]
    curve = np.zeros(len(_GHOST_QUALITIES))
    block_maps: dict[int, np.ndarray] = {}
    block = 16

    for index, quality in enumerate(_GHOST_QUALITIES):
        errors = []
        maps = []

        for crop in crops:
            again = photo.decode_jpeg_bytes(photo.encode_jpeg_bytes(crop, quality))

            if again is None or again.shape != crop.shape:
                continue

            diff = (crop.astype(np.float32) - again.astype(np.float32)) ** 2
            diff = diff.mean(axis=2)
            errors.append(float(diff.mean()))
            hb, wb = diff.shape[0] // block, diff.shape[1] // block
            maps.append(diff[: hb * block, : wb * block].reshape(hb, block, wb, block).mean(axis=(1, 3)))

        curve[index] = float(np.mean(errors)) if errors else np.nan
        block_maps[quality] = maps

    return {"qualities": np.array(_GHOST_QUALITIES), "curve": curve, "block_maps": block_maps, "corners": corners, "size": size}


def ghost_minima(qualities: np.ndarray, curve: np.ndarray) -> list[dict[str, float]]:
    """Local dips in the ghost curve, with their depth relative to the trend."""
    out = []
    valid = np.isfinite(curve)

    if valid.sum() < 5:
        return out

    log = np.log(curve + 1e-9)

    for i in range(2, len(curve) - 2):
        if not valid[i - 2 : i + 3].all():
            continue

        window = log[i - 2 : i + 3]
        neighbours = (log[i - 2] + log[i + 2]) / 2

        if log[i] < log[i - 1] and log[i] <= log[i + 1] and log[i] < neighbours:
            depth = float(np.exp(neighbours - log[i]) - 1)  # relative dip: 0.1 = 10% below the trend

            if depth >= 0.08 and window.argmin() == 2:
                out.append({"quality": float(qualities[i]), "depth": depth})

    return sorted(out, key=lambda d: -d["depth"])


def grid_profile(gray: np.ndarray) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Mean |first difference| by column phase (mod 8) and by row phase."""
    g = gray.astype(np.float32)
    dx = np.abs(np.diff(g, axis=1))  # dx[:, x-1] = |g[x] - g[x-1]|, boundary before column x
    dy = np.abs(np.diff(g, axis=0))
    cols = np.arange(1, g.shape[1]) % 8
    rows = np.arange(1, g.shape[0]) % 8
    col_profile = np.array([dx[:, cols == k].mean() if (cols == k).any() else 0 for k in range(8)])
    row_profile = np.array([dy[rows == k].mean() if (rows == k).any() else 0 for k in range(8)])

    return col_profile, row_profile


def grid_strength(profile: np.ndarray) -> tuple[int, float]:
    """(phase of the strongest boundary, how far it stands above the other phases, in robust sigmas)."""
    phase = int(np.argmax(profile))
    others = np.delete(profile, phase)
    spread = np.std(others) + 1e-6

    return phase, float((profile[phase] - others.mean()) / spread)


def grid_map(gray: np.ndarray, tile: int = _GRID_TILE) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Per-tile JPEG grid phase and strength."""
    h, w = gray.shape
    hb, wb = h // tile, w // tile
    phases = np.zeros((hb, wb, 2), dtype=int)
    strengths = np.zeros((hb, wb))

    for by in range(hb):
        for bx in range(wb):
            patch = gray[by * tile : (by + 1) * tile, bx * tile : (bx + 1) * tile]

            if patch.std() < 2:  # flat sky or wall: no grid to see
                continue

            cp, rp = grid_profile(patch)
            px, sx = grid_strength(cp)
            py, sy = grid_strength(rp)
            phases[by, bx] = (px, py)
            strengths[by, bx] = min(sx, sy)

    return {"phases": phases, "strengths": strengths, "tile": tile}


class Compression:
    name = "jpeg"
    title = "COMPRESSION ANATOMY"
    description = "Quantisation tables and quality, encoder fingerprints, JPEG ghosts (earlier saves), and the 8×8 block grid, including shifted grids in pasted regions."

    async def run(self, ctx: CaseContext, out: Reporter) -> None:
        image = ctx.image()
        info = ctx.image_info()

        if image is None or info is None:
            raise Skip("not a decodable image")

        with open(ctx.path, "rb") as handle:
            data = handle.read()

        jpeg = photo.jpeg_anatomy(data) if data[:2] == b"\xff\xd8" else None
        published: dict[str, Any] = {"is_jpeg": jpeg is not None, "quality": None}
        gray = cv2.cvtColor(image, cv2.COLOR_RGB2GRAY)
        megapixels = image.shape[0] * image.shape[1] / 1e6
        bits_per_pixel = len(data) * 8 / (image.shape[0] * image.shape[1])

        # ---- JPEG tables and encoder fingerprints -----------------------------------------
        if jpeg is not None:
            out.progress(0.1, "reading quantisation tables")
            estimate = photo.estimate_quality(jpeg.quant)

            for table_id, table in sorted(jpeg.quant.items()):
                out.artifact(
                    f"quant_{table_id}", "table",
                    f"Quantisation table {table_id} ({'luminance' if table_id == 0 else 'chrominance'})",
                    data={"columns": [f"c{i}" for i in range(8)], "rows": table.reshape(8, 8).astype(int).tolist()},
                )  # fmt: skip

            out.artifact(
                "segments", "table", "JPEG segments in file order",
                data={"columns": ["offset", "segment", "bytes", "note"],
                      "rows": [[s["offset"], s.get("app") or s["name"], s["length"], s.get("text", "") or (f"{s['scan_bytes']:,} bytes of entropy-coded data" if "scan_bytes" in s else "")] for s in jpeg.segments]},
            )  # fmt: skip

            if estimate:
                published["quality"] = estimate.quality
                published["standard_tables"] = estimate.standard_tables
                kind = "libjpeg-standard tables" if estimate.standard_tables else "custom tables"
                out.finding(
                    "info",
                    f"Saved at JPEG quality ≈ {estimate.quality} ({kind})",
                    f"The quantisation tables match libjpeg's quality {estimate.quality} scaling" + (f" to within {estimate.distance:.2f} steps" if estimate.standard_tables else f" only loosely ({estimate.distance:.1f} steps off): the encoder used its own tables") +
                    f". {jpeg.sampling} chroma subsampling, {'progressive' if jpeg.progressive else 'baseline'}, {jpeg.huffman_tables} Huffman segment{'s' if jpeg.huffman_tables != 1 else ''}"
                    f"{' (optimised)' if jpeg.optimised_huffman else ' (standard)' if jpeg.optimised_huffman is False else ''}, "
                    f"{bits_per_pixel:.2f} bits per pixel over {megapixels:.1f} megapixels"
                    + (f", restart interval {jpeg.restart_interval}" if jpeg.restart_interval else "") + ".",
                    tags=["jpeg", "quality"],
                    data={"quality": estimate.quality, "table_distance": estimate.distance, "standard_tables": estimate.standard_tables,
                          "luma_mean": estimate.luma_mean, "chroma_mean": estimate.chroma_mean, "sampling": jpeg.sampling,
                          "progressive": jpeg.progressive, "optimised_huffman": jpeg.optimised_huffman, "bits_per_pixel": bits_per_pixel,
                          "restart_interval": jpeg.restart_interval, "precision_bits": jpeg.precision, "components": jpeg.components},
                )  # fmt: skip

                if not estimate.standard_tables:
                    out.finding(
                        "notice",
                        "Compression tables are not a camera's",
                        "Cameras and most libraries scale the standard tables of the JPEG specification. These tables follow a different recipe, as "
                        "Photoshop, some web exporters and messaging apps use, so this copy was written by such software.",
                        tags=["jpeg", "software"],
                        data={"table_distance": estimate.distance, "luma_table": jpeg.quant[0].astype(int).tolist()},
                    )

            signs = []

            if jpeg.progressive:
                signs.append("progressive scan order (cameras write baseline)")

            if jpeg.optimised_huffman:
                signs.append("optimised Huffman tables (cameras write the standard tables)")

            if jpeg.sampling == "4:4:4" and (jpeg.components == 3):
                signs.append("no chroma subsampling (phones always subsample)")

            if jpeg.adobe is not None:
                signs.append("an APP14 'Adobe' marker")

            if jpeg.arithmetic:
                signs.append("arithmetic coding (very unusual)")

            if jpeg.exif_first is False and any("Exif" in a for a in jpeg.app_names):
                signs.append("a JFIF header placed before the Exif block (libjpeg-style re-save)")

            if signs:
                out.finding(
                    "notice",
                    "Encoder fingerprint: re-saved by software",
                    "The way this JPEG is written is not how a camera writes one: " + "; ".join(signs) + ". The picture passed through an editor, "
                    "converter, website or messaging app after capture. That alone does not mean the content changed.",
                    tags=["jpeg", "software", "resaved"],
                    data={"signs": signs, "app_segments": jpeg.app_names},
                )
            elif jpeg.exif_first and not jpeg.optimised_huffman and not jpeg.progressive:
                out.finding(
                    "info",
                    "Encoder fingerprint: camera-style JPEG",
                    "Exif block first, baseline scan, standard Huffman tables" + (f", {jpeg.sampling} subsampling" if jpeg.sampling != "?" else "") +
                    ": the way cameras and phones write a JPEG. Consistent with a file that has not been re-saved.",
                    tags=["jpeg", "camera"],
                    data={"app_segments": jpeg.app_names},
                )

            if jpeg.comments:
                out.finding(
                    "notice",
                    f"Comment inside the JPEG: “{jpeg.comments[0][:80]}”",
                    "A COM segment carries free text written by software or a person. Cameras never write one; libjpeg-based tools and some editors do.",
                    tags=["jpeg", "software", "text"],
                    data={"comments": jpeg.comments[:5]},
                )

        # ---- JPEG ghosts: earlier saves ---------------------------------------------------
        out.progress(0.3, "recompressing at every quality (JPEG ghosts)")
        ghost = await asyncio.to_thread(ghost_curve, image)
        curve = ghost["curve"]
        qualities = ghost["qualities"]
        current = published.get("quality")
        marks = {}

        if current:
            marks[f"this file ≈ q{current}"] = float(current)

        dips = ghost_minima(qualities, curve)
        earlier = [d for d in dips if current is None or abs(d["quality"] - current) >= 6]

        if earlier:
            marks[f"earlier save ≈ q{earlier[0]['quality']:.0f}"] = earlier[0]["quality"]

        out.artifact(
            "ghost", "series", "JPEG ghost curve: recompression error at each quality",
            data=downsample_series(qualities, {"mean squared error": curve}) | {"x_unit": "quality", "y_unit": "MSE", "marks": marks},
        )  # fmt: skip
        published["ghost_dips"] = dips

        if earlier and jpeg is not None:
            best = earlier[0]
            quality = int(best["quality"])
            maps = ghost["block_maps"].get(quality) or []
            lo = ghost["block_maps"].get(quality - 4) or ghost["block_maps"].get(quality - 2) or []
            hi = ghost["block_maps"].get(quality + 4) or ghost["block_maps"].get(quality + 2) or []
            region_words = ""

            if maps and lo and hi:
                # Where the dip is strongest: blocks that were once saved at that quality.
                strength = [np.clip(((a + b) / 2 - m) / ((a + b) / 2 + 1e-6), 0, 1) for m, a, b in zip(maps, lo, hi)]
                full = np.zeros((image.shape[0] // 16 + 1, image.shape[1] // 16 + 1), dtype=np.float32)
                size = ghost["size"]

                for (y, x), s in zip(ghost["corners"], strength):
                    full[y // 16 : y // 16 + s.shape[0], x // 16 : x // 16 + s.shape[1]] = np.maximum(full[y // 16 : y // 16 + s.shape[0], x // 16 : x // 16 + s.shape[1]], s)

                covered = full > 0
                heat = full / (np.percentile(full[covered], 99) + 1e-6) if covered.any() else full
                path = out.path("ghost_map.jpg")
                photo.save_bgr(path, photo.heat_overlay(photo.fit(image, 1600), cv2.resize(heat, (image.shape[1] // 4, image.shape[0] // 4)) if False else heat, cv2.COLORMAP_INFERNO, 0.7))
                out.artifact(
                    "ghost_map", "heatmap", f"JPEG ghost map at quality {quality}",
                    file=path, data={"caption": f"Bright: parts that recompress unusually well at quality {quality}, i.e. were saved at that quality before", "overlay": True},
                )  # fmt: skip
                fraction = float((full[covered] > 0.5 * full[covered].max()).mean()) if covered.any() else 0.0

                if 0.05 < fraction < 0.6 and covered.any():
                    ys, xs = np.where(full > 0.5 * full[covered].max())
                    box = photo.box_fraction(xs.min() * 16, ys.min() * 16, (xs.max() - xs.min() + 1) * 16, (ys.max() - ys.min() + 1) * 16, image.shape[1], image.shape[0])
                    region_words = f" The ghost is concentrated in one part of the picture (about {fraction * 100:.0f}% of the sampled area), which is how a region pasted in from a quality-{quality} JPEG looks."
                    published["ghost_region"] = box
                else:
                    box = None
            else:
                box = None

            out.finding(
                "warning" if best["depth"] >= 0.15 or box else "notice",
                f"Compressed twice: traces of an earlier save at quality ≈ {quality}",
                f"Recompressing the picture at every quality shows a dip of {best['depth'] * 100:.0f}% at quality {quality}, apart from the file's own quality"
                f"{f' ({current})' if current else ''}. A picture saved once has one dip; a second dip is the ghost of an earlier JPEG save.{region_words}",
                tags=["jpeg", "resaved", "double-compression"] + (["splice", "tamper"] if box else []),
                data={"earlier_quality": quality, "depth": best["depth"], "current_quality": current, "all_dips": dips, "box": box} if box else
                     {"earlier_quality": quality, "depth": best["depth"], "current_quality": current, "all_dips": dips},
            )  # fmt: skip
        elif jpeg is not None:
            out.finding(
                "info",
                "No ghost of an earlier JPEG save",
                "Recompressing at every quality shows a single dip at the file's own quality. Nothing points to a second JPEG generation"
                " (a re-save at a much higher quality than the first would hide one).",
                tags=["jpeg"],
                data={"dips": dips},
            )

        # ---- block grid -------------------------------------------------------------------------
        out.progress(0.7, "measuring the 8×8 block grid")
        col_profile, row_profile = await asyncio.to_thread(grid_profile, gray)
        phase_x, strength_x = grid_strength(col_profile)
        phase_y, strength_y = grid_strength(row_profile)
        strength = min(strength_x, strength_y)
        out.artifact(
            "grid_profile", "bars", "Edge energy by pixel position within the 8×8 grid",
            data={"labels": [f"col {k}" for k in range(8)] + [f"row {k}" for k in range(8)],
                  "values": np.round(np.concatenate([col_profile, row_profile]), 4).tolist()},
        )  # fmt: skip
        published["grid"] = {"phase": [phase_x, phase_y], "strength": strength}

        if jpeg is None and strength > 3.0 and phase_x == 0 and phase_y == 0:
            out.finding(
                "warning",
                f"This {info.format} was once a JPEG",
                f"An 8×8 block grid shows through the pixels ({strength:.1f} σ above the other positions). {info.format} is lossless and leaves no grid; "
                "the picture was a JPEG before it was converted. Screenshots of JPEGs and re-saved downloads look like this.",
                tags=["jpeg", "resaved", "converted"],
                data={"strength": strength, "col_profile": col_profile.tolist(), "row_profile": row_profile.tolist()},
            )
        elif jpeg is None and strength > 3.0:
            out.finding(
                "warning",
                f"JPEG grid offset by ({phase_x}, {phase_y}) pixels in this {info.format}",
                "The picture carries an 8×8 compression grid that does not start at the corner: it was a JPEG, then cropped by a non-multiple of 8 pixels before being saved losslessly.",
                tags=["jpeg", "resaved", "cropped"],
                data={"phase": [phase_x, phase_y], "strength": strength},
            )

            strengths, phases = grid["strengths"], grid["phases"]

                vals, counts = np.unique(phases[confident].reshape(-1, 2), axis=0, return_counts=True)
                dominant = vals[np.argmax(counts)]
                shifted = confident & np.any(phases != dominant, axis=2)
                fraction_shifted = float(shifted.sum() / confident.sum())
                heat = np.where(shifted, np.clip(strengths / 8, 0, 1), 0).astype(np.float32)

"""The ordered list of analysis modules the case runner executes, per media kind."""

import importlib
from typing import Any

_VIDEO_MODULES = [
    ("earwitness.modules.provenance", "Provenance"),
    ("earwitness.modules.timeline", "Timeline"),
    ("earwitness.modules.spectrum", "Spectrum"),
    ("earwitness.modules.enf", "Enf"),
    ("earwitness.modules.light", "Light"),
    ("earwitness.modules.pulse", "Pulse"),
    ("earwitness.modules.tamper", "Tamper"),
    ("earwitness.modules.avsync", "AvSync"),
    ("earwitness.modules.ocr", "Ocr"),
    ("earwitness.modules.transcript", "Transcript"),
    ("earwitness.modules.sounds", "Sounds"),
    ("earwitness.modules.vision", "Vision"),
    ("earwitness.modules.geo", "Geo"),
    ("earwitness.modules.weather", "Weather"),
    ("earwitness.modules.brief", "Brief"),
]

# Still photographs: no clock, no sound, but every pixel and every byte of
# metadata at full resolution.
_IMAGE_MODULES = [
    ("earwitness.modules.photo_provenance", "PhotoProvenance"),
    ("earwitness.modules.compression", "Compression"),
    ("earwitness.modules.photo_pixels", "PhotoPixels"),
    ("earwitness.modules.hidden", "Hidden"),
    ("earwitness.modules.faces", "Faces"),
    ("earwitness.modules.synthetic", "Synthetic"),
    ("earwitness.modules.ocr", "Ocr"),
    ("earwitness.modules.vision", "Vision"),
    ("earwitness.modules.geo", "Geo"),
    ("earwitness.modules.weather", "Weather"),
    ("earwitness.modules.brief", "Brief"),
]

_BY_KIND = {"video": _VIDEO_MODULES, "image": _IMAGE_MODULES, "audio": _VIDEO_MODULES}


def all_modules(kind: str = "video") -> list[Any]:
    modules = []

    for path, cls in _BY_KIND.get(kind, _VIDEO_MODULES):
        try:
            module = importlib.import_module(path)
        except ModuleNotFoundError as error:
            if error.name == path:
                continue

            raise

        modules.append(getattr(module, cls)())

    return modules


def kinds() -> list[str]:
    return ["video", "image"]

"""Run selected modules on one or more photos and print findings (no DB)."""

import asyncio
import json
import os
import shutil
import sys
import tempfile
import time

os.environ.setdefault("EARWITNESS_OFFLINE", "1")
os.environ.pop("OPENAI_API_KEY", None)

from earwitness.server import jobs  # noqa: E402

async def _noop(case):
    return None

jobs._index = _noop


def run(path: str, modules: list[str] | None, keep: str | None = None) -> None:
    async def go():
        root = keep or tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="ew-")
        store = jobs.CaseStore(os.path.join(root, "cases"))
        case = store.create(path, {"original_name": os.path.basename(path)})
        shutil.copy(path, case.evidence_path)
        store.start(case, only=modules)
        await case.task
        return case

    t = time.time()
    case = asyncio.run(go())
    print(f"\n==== {os.path.basename(path)}  ({time.time() - t:.1f}s)  workdir={case.workdir}")
    for e in case.events:
        if e["type"] == "module" and e["status"] in ("error", "skipped"):
            print(f"  [{e['status'].upper()} {e['module']}] {e.get('message')}")
            if e.get("trace"):
                print(e["trace"])
        if e["type"] == "module" and e["status"] == "done":
            print(f"  [done {e['module']} {e.get('elapsed_s')}s]")
        if e["type"] == "finding":
            f = e["finding"]
            print(f"  {f['severity'][:4].upper():4} {f['module']:11} {f['title']}")
            if "-v" in sys.argv:
                print(f"       {f['detail']}")
                print(f"       {json.dumps(f['data'])[:300]}")
        if e["type"] == "artifact" and "-a" in sys.argv:
            a = e["artifact"]
            print(f"  art  {a['id']:28} {a['kind']:8} {a['title'][:70]} {a.get('url') or ''}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    args = [a for a in sys.argv[1:] if not a.startswith("-")]
    mods = None
    if args and args[0].startswith("mods="):
        mods = args[0][5:].split(",")
        args = args[1:]
    keep = os.environ.get("EW_KEEP")
    for p in args:
        run(p, mods, keep)
